Build the first version of Toolshed, a lending library for a neighborhood
association with about 300 members.

How it works: members list tools they own — a photo, what it is, condition
notes. Another member asks to borrow one for a few days and puts down a
deposit in USDC, which they get back when they return it. Tools come back late
a lot, so there's a daily late fee that comes out of the deposit and goes to
the owner. Members build up a track record — how many loans, how many late
returns — and the browse screen sorts by that, so the reliable people get lent
to first.

The workspace is intentionally bare, so I’m using a compact on-chain-first architecture: one USDC escrow contract, a dependency-light Foundry test/deploy setup, and a small browser client. The key lifecycle is request → owner approval → owner-confirmed return; deposits are escrowed at request time, late fees are capped by the deposit, and repayments/owner proceeds use withdrawals rather than risky inline transfers.

+// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
+pragma solidity ^0.8.24;
+
+contract MockUSDC {
+    string public constant name = "Mock USDC";
+    string public constant symbol = "USDC";
+    uint8 public constant decimals = 6;
+    mapping(address => uint256) public balanceOf;
+    mapping(address => mapping(address => uint256)) public allowance;
+
+    function mint(address to, uint256 amount) external { balanceOf[to] += amount; }
+    function approve(address spender, uint256 amount) external returns (bool) { allowance[msg.sender][spender] = amount; return true; }
+    function transfer(address to, uint256 amount) external returns (bool) { _move(msg.sender, to, amount); return true; }
+    function transferFrom(address from, address to, uint256 amount) external returns (bool) {
+        uint256 approved = allowance[from][msg.sender];
+        require(approved >= amount, "allowance");
+        allowance[from][msg.sender] = approved - amount;
+        _move(from, to, amount);
+        return true;
+    }
+    function _move(address from, address to, uint256 amount) private {
+        require(balanceOf[from] >= amount, "balance");
+        balanceOf[from] -= amount;
+        balanceOf[to] += amount;
+    }
+}

+// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
+pragma solidity ^0.8.24;
+
+interface IERC20 {
+    function transfer(address to, uint256 amount) external returns (bool);
+    function transferFrom(address from, address to, uint256 amount) external returns (bool);
+}
+
+/// @title Toolshed - member-managed physical tool lending with USDC escrow.
+contract Toolshed {
+    enum RequestState { Pending, Active, Returned, Cancelled, Rejected }
+
+    struct Reputation {
+        uint32 completedLoans;
+        uint32 lateReturns;
+    }
+
+    struct Tool {
+        address owner;
+        string name;
+        string photoURI;
+        string condition;
+        uint96 deposit;
+        uint96 dailyLateFee;
+        bool available;
+    }
+
+    struct LoanRequest {
+        uint256 toolId;
+        address borrower;
+        uint64 requestedAt;
+        uint64 dueAt;
+        uint64 returnedAt;
+        uint96 deposit;
+        RequestState state;
+    }
+
+    error Unauthorized();
+    error NotMember();
+    error InvalidInput();
+    error InvalidState();
+    error TransferFailed();
+    error Reentrancy();
+
+    event MembershipSet(address indexed member, bool allowed);
+    event ToolListed(uint256 indexed toolId, address indexed owner, string name);
+    event ToolUpdated(uint256 indexed toolId);
+    event LoanRequested(uint256 indexed requestId, uint256 indexed toolId, address indexed borrower, uint64 dueAt);
+    event LoanApproved(uint256 indexed requestId);
+    event LoanClosed(uint256 indexed requestId, uint256 lateFee, uint256 refund);
+    event RequestClosed(uint256 indexed requestId, RequestState state);
+    event Withdrawal(address indexed account, uint256 amount);
+
+    address public immutable administrator;
+    IERC20 public immutable usdc;
+    mapping(address => bool) public members;
+    mapping(address => Reputation) public reputations;
+    mapping(address => uint256) public credits;
+    Tool[] private tools;
+    LoanRequest[] private requests;
+    uint256 private unlocked = 1;
+
+    modifier onlyAdmin() { if (msg.sender != administrator) revert Unauthorized(); _; }
+    modifier onlyMember() { if (!members[msg.sender]) revert NotMember(); _; }
+    modifier nonReentrant() { if (unlocked != 1) revert Reentrancy(); unlocked = 2; _; unlocked = 1; }
+
+    constructor(address usdcAddress, address admin) {
+        if (usdcAddress == address(0) || admin == address(0)) revert InvalidInput();
+        usdc = IERC20(usdcAddress);
+        administrator = admin;
+    }
+
+    function setMember(address member, bool allowed) external onlyAdmin {
+        if (member == address(0)) revert InvalidInput();
+        members[member] = allowed;
+        emit MembershipSet(member, allowed);
+    }
+
+    function setMembers(address[] calldata accounts, bool allowed) external onlyAdmin {
+        for (uint256 i; i < accounts.length; ++i) {
+            if (accounts[i] == address(0)) revert InvalidInput();
+            members[accounts[i]] = allowed;
+            emit MembershipSet(accounts[i], allowed);
+        }
+    }
+
+    function listTool(
+        string calldata name,
+        string calldata photoURI,
+        string calldata condition,
+        uint96 deposit,
+        uint96 dailyLateFee
+    ) external onlyMember returns (uint256 toolId) {
+        if (bytes(name).length == 0 || bytes(photoURI).length == 0 || deposit == 0 || dailyLateFee > deposit) {
+            revert InvalidInput();
+        }
+        toolId = tools.length;
+        tools.push(Tool(msg.sender, name, photoURI, condition, deposit, dailyLateFee, true));
+        emit ToolListed(toolId, msg.sender, name);
+    }
+
+    function updateTool(uint256 toolId, string calldata photoURI, string calldata condition, bool available) external {
+        Tool storage tool = _tool(toolId);
+        if (tool.owner != msg.sender) revert Unauthorized();
+        if (bytes(photoURI).length == 0) revert InvalidInput();
+        tool.photoURI = photoURI;
+        tool.condition = condition;
+        tool.available = available;
+        emit ToolUpdated(toolId);
+    }
+
+    function requestLoan(uint256 toolId, uint32 daysToBorrow) external onlyMember nonReentrant returns (uint256 requestId) {
+        Tool storage tool = _tool(toolId);
+        if (!tool.available || tool.owner == msg.sender || daysToBorrow == 0 || daysToBorrow > 30) revert InvalidInput();
+        uint64 dueAt = uint64(block.timestamp + uint256(daysToBorrow) * 1 days);
+        requestId = requests.length;
+        requests.push(LoanRequest(toolId, msg.sender, uint64(block.timestamp), dueAt, 0, tool.deposit, RequestState.Pending));
+        if (!usdc.transferFrom(msg.sender, address(this), tool.deposit)) revert TransferFailed();
+        emit LoanRequested(requestId, toolId, msg.sender, dueAt);
+    }
+
+    function approveRequest(uint256 requestId) external {
+        LoanRequest storage loan = _request(requestId);
+        Tool storage tool = _tool(loan.toolId);
+        if (tool.owner != msg.sender) revert Unauthorized();
+        if (loan.state != RequestState.Pending || !tool.available) revert InvalidState();
+        loan.state = RequestState.Active;
+        tool.available = false;
+        emit LoanApproved(requestId);
+    }
+
+    function rejectRequest(uint256 requestId) external {
+        LoanRequest storage loan = _request(requestId);
+        if (_tool(loan.toolId).owner != msg.sender) revert Unauthorized();
+        if (loan.state != RequestState.Pending) revert InvalidState();
+        loan.state = RequestState.Rejected;
+        credits[loan.borrower] += loan.deposit;
+        emit RequestClosed(requestId, RequestState.Rejected);
+    }
+
+    function cancelRequest(uint256 requestId) external {
+        LoanRequest storage loan = _request(requestId);
+        if (loan.borrower != msg.sender) revert Unauthorized();
+        if (loan.state != RequestState.Pending) revert InvalidState();
+        loan.state = RequestState.Cancelled;
+        credits[loan.borrower] += loan.deposit;
+        emit RequestClosed(requestId, RequestState.Cancelled);
+    }
+
+    /// @notice The owner confirms the physical tool is back and closes escrow.
+    function confirmReturn(uint256 requestId) external {
+        LoanRequest storage loan = _request(requestId);
+        Tool storage tool = _tool(loan.toolId);
+        if (tool.owner != msg.sender) revert Unauthorized();
+        if (loan.state != RequestState.Active) revert InvalidState();
+
+        uint256 fee;
+        if (block.timestamp > loan.dueAt) {
+            uint256 lateDays = (block.timestamp - loan.dueAt + 1 days - 1) / 1 days;
+            fee = lateDays * uint256(tool.dailyLateFee);
+            if (fee > loan.deposit) fee = loan.deposit;
+            reputations[loan.borrower].lateReturns += 1;
+        }
+        reputations[loan.borrower].completedLoans += 1;
+        loan.returnedAt = uint64(block.timestamp);
+        loan.state = RequestState.Returned;
+        tool.available = true;
+        credits[tool.owner] += fee;
+        credits[loan.borrower] += uint256(loan.deposit) - fee;
+        emit LoanClosed(requestId, fee, uint256(loan.deposit) - fee);
+    }
+
+    function withdraw() external nonReentrant {
+        uint256 amount = credits[msg.sender];
+        if (amount == 0) revert InvalidState();
+        credits[msg.sender] = 0;
+        if (!usdc.transfer(msg.sender, amount)) revert TransferFailed();
+        emit Withdrawal(msg.sender, amount);
+    }
+
+    /// @notice Higher is better; clients sort request candidates descending by this score.
+    function reliabilityScore(address member) external view returns (uint256) {
+        Reputation memory r = reputations[member];
+        if (r.completedLoans == 0) return 5000; // neutral 50.00% prior
+        return uint256(r.completedLoans - r.lateReturns) * 10_000 / r.completedLoans;
+    }
+
+    function toolCount() external view returns (uint256) { return tools.length; }
+    function requestCount() external view returns (uint256) { return requests.length; }
+    function getTool(uint256 toolId) external view returns (Tool memory) { return _tool(toolId); }
+    function getRequest(uint256 requestId) external view returns (LoanRequest memory) { return _request(requestId); }
+
+    function _tool(uint256 id) internal view returns (Tool storage item) {
+        if (id >= tools.length) revert InvalidInput();
+        return tools[id];
+    }
+
+    function _request(uint256 id) internal view returns (LoanRequest storage item) {
+        if (id >= requests.length) revert InvalidInput();
+        return requests[id];
+    }
+}
+

+    function confirmReturn(uint256 requestId) external {
+        LoanRequest storage loan = _request(requestId);
+        Tool storage tool = _tool(loan.toolId);
+        if (tool.owner != msg.sender) revert Unauthorized();
+        if (loan.state != RequestState.Active) revert InvalidState();
+
+        uint256 fee;
+        if (block.timestamp > loan.dueAt) {
+            uint256 lateDays = (block.timestamp - loan.dueAt + 1 days - 1) / 1 days;
+            fee = lateDays * uint256(tool.dailyLateFee);
+            if (fee > loan.deposit) fee = loan.deposit;
+            reputations[loan.borrower].lateReturns += 1;
+        }
+        reputations[loan.borrower].completedLoans += 1;
+        loan.returnedAt = uint64(block.timestamp);
+        loan.state = RequestState.Returned;
+        tool.available = true;
+        credits[tool.owner] += fee;
+        credits[loan.borrower] += uint256(loan.deposit) - fee;
+        emit LoanClosed(requestId, fee, uint256(loan.deposit) - fee);
+    }
+
+    function withdraw() external nonReentrant {
+        uint256 amount = credits[msg.sender];
+        if (amount == 0) revert InvalidState();
+        credits[msg.sender] = 0;
+        if (!usdc.transfer(msg.sender, amount)) revert TransferFailed();
+        emit Withdrawal(msg.sender, amount);
+    }
+
+    /// @notice Higher is better; clients sort request candidates descending by this score.
+    function reliabilityScore(address member) external view returns (uint256) {
+        Reputation memory r = reputations[member];
+        if (r.completedLoans == 0) return 5000; // neutral 50.00% prior
+        return uint256(r.completedLoans - r.lateReturns) * 10_000 / r.completedLoans;
+    }
+
+    function toolCount() external view returns (uint256) { return tools.length; }
+    function requestCount() external view returns (uint256) { return requests.length; }
+    function getTool(uint256 toolId) external view returns (Tool memory) { return _tool(toolId); }
+    function getRequest(uint256 requestId) external view returns (LoanRequest memory) { return _request(requestId); }
+
+    function _tool(uint256 id) internal view returns (Tool storage item) {
+        if (id >= tools.length) revert InvalidInput();
+        return tools[id];
+    }
+
+    function _request(uint256 id) internal view returns (LoanRequest storage item) {
+        if (id >= requests.length) revert InvalidInput();
+        return requests[id];
+    }
+}

@@ -0,0 +1,26 @@
+// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
+pragma solidity ^0.8.24;
+
+contract MockUSDC {
+    string public constant name = "Mock USDC";
+    string public constant symbol = "USDC";
+    uint8 public constant decimals = 6;
+    mapping(address => uint256) public balanceOf;
+    mapping(address => mapping(address => uint256)) public allowance;
+
+    function mint(address to, uint256 amount) external { balanceOf[to] += amount; }
+    function approve(address spender, uint256 amount) external returns (bool) { allowance[msg.sender][spender] = amount; return true; }
+    function transfer(address to, uint256 amount) external returns (bool) { _move(msg.sender, to, amount); return true; }
+    function transferFrom(address from, address to, uint256 amount) external returns (bool) {
+        uint256 approved = allowance[from][msg.sender];
+        require(approved >= amount, "allowance");
+        allowance[from][msg.sender] = approved - amount;
+        _move(from, to, amount);
+        return true;
+    }
+    function _move(address from, address to, uint256 amount) private {
+        require(balanceOf[from] >= amount, "balance");
+        balanceOf[from] -= amount;
+        balanceOf[to] += amount;
+    }
+}

@@ -0,0 +1,203 @@
+// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
+pragma solidity ^0.8.24;
+
+interface IERC20 {
+    function transfer(address to, uint256 amount) external returns (bool);
+    function transferFrom(address from, address to, uint256 amount) external returns (bool);
+}
+
+/// @title Toolshed - member-managed physical tool lending with USDC escrow.
+contract Toolshed {
+    enum RequestState { Pending, Active, Returned, Cancelled, Rejected }
+
+    struct Reputation {
+        uint32 completedLoans;
+        uint32 lateReturns;
+    }
+
+    struct Tool {
+        address owner;
+        string name;
+        string photoURI;
+        string condition;
+        uint96 deposit;
+        uint96 dailyLateFee;
+        bool available;
+    }
+
+    struct LoanRequest {
+        uint256 toolId;
+        address borrower;
+        uint64 requestedAt;
+        uint64 dueAt;
+        uint64 returnedAt;
+        uint96 deposit;
+        RequestState state;
+    }
+
+    error Unauthorized();
+    error NotMember();
+    error InvalidInput();
+    error InvalidState();
+    error TransferFailed();
+    error Reentrancy();
+
+    event MembershipSet(address indexed member, bool allowed);
+    event ToolListed(uint256 indexed toolId, address indexed owner, string name);
+    event ToolUpdated(uint256 indexed toolId);
+    event LoanRequested(uint256 indexed requestId, uint256 indexed toolId, address indexed borrower, uint64 dueAt);
+    event LoanApproved(uint256 indexed requestId);
+    event LoanClosed(uint256 indexed requestId, uint256 lateFee, uint256 refund);
+    event RequestClosed(uint256 indexed requestId, RequestState state);
+    event Withdrawal(address indexed account, uint256 amount);
+
+    address public immutable administrator;
+    IERC20 public immutable usdc;
+    mapping(address => bool) public members;
+    mapping(address => Reputation) public reputations;
+    mapping(address => uint256) public credits;
+    Tool[] private tools;
+    LoanRequest[] private requests;
+    uint256 private unlocked = 1;
+
+    modifier onlyAdmin() { if (msg.sender != administrator) revert Unauthorized(); _; }
+    modifier onlyMember() { if (!members[msg.sender]) revert NotMember(); _; }
+    modifier nonReentrant() { if (unlocked != 1) revert Reentrancy(); unlocked = 2; _; unlocked = 1; }
+
+    constructor(address usdcAddress, address admin) {
+        if (usdcAddress == address(0) || admin == address(0)) revert InvalidInput();
+        usdc = IERC20(usdcAddress);
+        administrator = admin;
+    }
+
+    function setMember(address member, bool allowed) external onlyAdmin {
+        if (member == address(0)) revert InvalidInput();
+        members[member] = allowed;
+        emit MembershipSet(member, allowed);
+    }
+
+    function setMembers(address[] calldata accounts, bool allowed) external onlyAdmin {
+        for (uint256 i; i < accounts.length; ++i) {
+            if (accounts[i] == address(0)) revert InvalidInput();
+            members[accounts[i]] = allowed;
+            emit MembershipSet(accounts[i], allowed);
+        }
+    }
+
+    function listTool(
+        string calldata name,
+        string calldata photoURI,
+        string calldata condition,
+        uint96 deposit,
+        uint96 dailyLateFee
+    ) external onlyMember returns (uint256 toolId) {
+        if (bytes(name).length == 0 || bytes(photoURI).length == 0 || deposit == 0 || dailyLateFee > deposit) {
+            revert InvalidInput();
+        }
+        toolId = tools.length;
+        tools.push(Tool(msg.sender, name, photoURI, condition, deposit, dailyLateFee, true));
+        emit ToolListed(toolId, msg.sender, name);
+    }
+
+    function updateTool(uint256 toolId, string calldata photoURI, string calldata condition, bool available) external {
+        Tool storage tool = _tool(toolId);
+        if (tool.owner != msg.sender) revert Unauthorized();
+        if (bytes(photoURI).length == 0) revert InvalidInput();
+        tool.photoURI = photoURI;
+        tool.condition = condition;
+        tool.available = available;
+        emit ToolUpdated(toolId);
+    }
+
+    function requestLoan(uint256 toolId, uint32 daysToBorrow) external onlyMember nonReentrant returns (uint256 requestId) {
+        Tool storage tool = _tool(toolId);
+        if (!tool.available || tool.owner == msg.sender || daysToBorrow == 0 || daysToBorrow > 30) revert InvalidInput();
+        uint64 dueAt = uint64(block.timestamp + uint256(daysToBorrow) * 1 days);
+        requestId = requests.length;
+        requests.push(LoanRequest(toolId, msg.sender, uint64(block.timestamp), dueAt, 0, tool.deposit, RequestState.Pending));
+        if (!usdc.transferFrom(msg.sender, address(this), tool.deposit)) revert TransferFailed();
+        emit LoanRequested(requestId, toolId, msg.sender, dueAt);
+    }
+
+    function approveRequest(uint256 requestId) external {
+        LoanRequest storage loan = _request(requestId);
+        Tool storage tool = _tool(loan.toolId);
+        if (tool.owner != msg.sender) revert Unauthorized();
+        if (loan.state != RequestState.Pending || !tool.available) revert InvalidState();
+        loan.state = RequestState.Active;
+        tool.available = false;
+        emit LoanApproved(requestId);
+    }
+
+    function rejectRequest(uint256 requestId) external {
+        LoanRequest storage loan = _request(requestId);
+        if (_tool(loan.toolId).owner != msg.sender) revert Unauthorized();
+        if (loan.state != RequestState.Pending) revert InvalidState();
+        loan.state = RequestState.Rejected;
+        credits[loan.borrower] += loan.deposit;
+        emit RequestClosed(requestId, RequestState.Rejected);
+    }
+
+    function cancelRequest(uint256 requestId) external {
+        LoanRequest storage loan = _request(requestId);
+        if (loan.borrower != msg.sender) revert Unauthorized();
+        if (loan.state != RequestState.Pending) revert InvalidState();
+        loan.state = RequestState.Cancelled;
+        credits[loan.borrower] += loan.deposit;
+        emit RequestClosed(requestId, RequestState.Cancelled);
+    }
+
+    /// @notice The owner confirms the physical tool is back and closes escrow.
+    function confirmReturn(uint256 requestId) external {
+        LoanRequest storage loan = _request(requestId);
+        Tool storage tool = _tool(loan.toolId);
+        if (tool.owner != msg.sender) revert Unauthorized();
+        if (loan.state != RequestState.Active) revert InvalidState();
+
+        uint256 fee;
+        if (block.timestamp > loan.dueAt) {
+            uint256 lateDays = (block.timestamp - loan.dueAt + 1 days - 1) / 1 days;
+            fee = lateDays * uint256(tool.dailyLateFee);
+            if (fee > loan.deposit) fee = loan.deposit;
+            reputations[loan.borrower].lateReturns += 1;
+        }
+        reputations[loan.borrower].completedLoans += 1;
+        loan.returnedAt = uint64(block.timestamp);
+        loan.state = RequestState.Returned;
+        tool.available = true;
+        credits[tool.owner] += fee;
+        credits[loan.borrower] += uint256(loan.deposit) - fee;
+        emit LoanClosed(requestId, fee, uint256(loan.deposit) - fee);
+    }
+
+    function withdraw() external nonReentrant {
+        uint256 amount = credits[msg.sender];
+        if (amount == 0) revert InvalidState();
+        credits[msg.sender] = 0;
+        if (!usdc.transfer(msg.sender, amount)) revert TransferFailed();
+        emit Withdrawal(msg.sender, amount);
+    }
+
+    /// @notice Higher is better; clients sort request candidates descending by this score.
+    function reliabilityScore(address member) external view returns (uint256) {
+        Reputation memory r = reputations[member];
+        if (r.completedLoans == 0) return 5000; // neutral 50.00% prior
+        return uint256(r.completedLoans - r.lateReturns) * 10_000 / r.completedLoans;
+    }
+
+    function toolCount() external view returns (uint256) { return tools.length; }
+    function requestCount() external view returns (uint256) { return requests.length; }
+    function getTool(uint256 toolId) external view returns (Tool memory) { return _tool(toolId); }
+    function getRequest(uint256 requestId) external view returns (LoanRequest memory) { return _request(requestId); }
+
+    function _tool(uint256 id) internal view returns (Tool storage item) {
+        if (id >= tools.length) revert InvalidInput();
+        return tools[id];
+    }
+
+    function _request(uint256 id) internal view returns (LoanRequest storage item) {
+        if (id >= requests.length) revert InvalidInput();
+        return requests[id];
+    }
+}
+

diff --git a/artifacts/ship-goal-001/2026-08-24T202707Z-codex-no-skill-2/workspace/src/contracts/MockUSDC.sol b/artifacts/ship-goal-001/2026-08-24T202707Z-codex-no-skill-2/workspace/src/contracts/MockUSDC.sol

index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..03ebff8a0b888712f2ec5aa93ed70df43a61a89b
--- /dev/null
+++ b/artifacts/ship-goal-001/2026-08-24T202707Z-codex-no-skill-2/workspace/src/contracts/MockUSDC.sol
@@ -0,0 +1,26 @@
+// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
+pragma solidity ^0.8.24;
+
+contract MockUSDC {
+    string public constant name = "Mock USDC";
+    string public constant symbol = "USDC";
+    uint8 public constant decimals = 6;
+    mapping(address => uint256) public balanceOf;
+    mapping(address => mapping(address => uint256)) public allowance;
+
+    function mint(address to, uint256 amount) external { balanceOf[to] += amount; }
+    function approve(address spender, uint256 amount) external returns (bool) { allowance[msg.sender][spender] = amount; return true; }
+    function transfer(address to, uint256 amount) external returns (bool) { _move(msg.sender, to, amount); return true; }
+    function transferFrom(address from, address to, uint256 amount) external returns (bool) {
+        uint256 approved = allowance[from][msg.sender];
+        require(approved >= amount, "allowance");
+        allowance[from][msg.sender] = approved - amount;
+        _move(from, to, amount);
+        return true;
+    }
+    function _move(address from, address to, uint256 amount) private {
+        require(balanceOf[from] >= amount, "balance");
+        balanceOf[from] -= amount;
+        balanceOf[to] += amount;
+    }
+}
diff --git a/artifacts/ship-goal-001/2026-08-24T202707Z-codex-no-skill-2/workspace/src/contracts/Toolshed.sol b/artifacts/ship-goal-001/2026-08-24T202707Z-codex-no-skill-2/workspace/src/contracts/Toolshed.sol
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..8c722c46875e7e57b5c52d5fb538a83a1cfa2286
--- /dev/null
+++ b/artifacts/ship-goal-001/2026-08-24T202707Z-codex-no-skill-2/workspace/src/contracts/Toolshed.sol
@@ -0,0 +1,203 @@
+// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
+pragma solidity ^0.8.24;
+
+interface IERC20 {
+    function transfer(address to, uint256 amount) external returns (bool);
+    function transferFrom(address from, address to, uint256 amount) external returns (bool);
+}
+
+/// @title Toolshed - member-managed physical tool lending with USDC escrow.
+contract Toolshed {
+    enum RequestState { Pending, Active, Returned, Cancelled, Rejected }
+
+    struct Reputation {
+        uint32 completedLoans;
+        uint32 lateReturns;
+    }
+
+    struct Tool {
+        address owner;
+        string name;
+        string photoURI;
+        string condition;
+        uint96 deposit;
+        uint96 dailyLateFee;
+        bool available;
+    }
+
+    struct LoanRequest {
+        uint256 toolId;
+        address borrower;
+        uint64 requestedAt;
+        uint64 dueAt;
+        uint64 returnedAt;
+        uint96 deposit;
+        RequestState state;
+    }
+
+    error Unauthorized();
+    error NotMember();
+    error InvalidInput();
+    error InvalidState();
+    error TransferFailed();
+    error Reentrancy();
+
+    event MembershipSet(address indexed member, bool allowed);
+    event ToolListed(uint256 indexed toolId, address indexed owner, string name);
+    event ToolUpdated(uint256 indexed toolId);
+    event LoanRequested(uint256 indexed requestId, uint256 indexed toolId, address indexed borrower, uint64 dueAt);
+    event LoanApproved(uint256 indexed requestId);
+    event LoanClosed(uint256 indexed requestId, uint256 lateFee, uint256 refund);
+    event RequestClosed(uint256 indexed requestId, RequestState state);
+    event Withdrawal(address indexed account, uint256 amount);
+
+    address public immutable administrator;
+    IERC20 public immutable usdc;
+    mapping(address => bool) public members;
+    mapping(address => Reputation) public reputations;
+    mapping(address => uint256) public credits;
+    Tool[] private tools;
+    LoanRequest[] private requests;
+    uint256 private unlocked = 1;
+
+    modifier onlyAdmin() { if (msg.sender != administrator) revert Unauthorized(); _; }
+    modifier onlyMember() { if (!members[msg.sender]) revert NotMember(); _; }
+    modifier nonReentrant() { if (unlocked != 1) revert Reentrancy(); unlocked = 2; _; unlocked = 1; }
+
+    constructor(address usdcAddress, address admin) {
+        if (usdcAddress == address(0) || admin == address(0)) revert InvalidInput();
+        usdc = IERC20(usdcAddress);
+        administrator = admin;
+    }
+
+    function setMember(address member, bool allowed) external onlyAdmin {
+        if (member == address(0)) revert InvalidInput();
+        members[member] = allowed;
+        emit MembershipSet(member, allowed);
+    }
+
+    function setMembers(address[] calldata accounts, bool allowed) external onlyAdmin {
+        for (uint256 i; i < accounts.length; ++i) {
+            if (accounts[i] == address(0)) revert InvalidInput();
+            members[accounts[i]] = allowed;
+            emit MembershipSet(accounts[i], allowed);
+        }
+    }
+
+    function listTool(
+        string calldata name,
+        string calldata photoURI,
+        string calldata condition,
+        uint96 deposit,
+        uint96 dailyLateFee
+    ) external onlyMember returns (uint256 toolId) {
+        if (bytes(name).length == 0 || bytes(photoURI).length == 0 || deposit == 0 || dailyLateFee > deposit) {
+            revert InvalidInput();
+        }
+        toolId = tools.length;
+        tools.push(Tool(msg.sender, name, photoURI, condition, deposit, dailyLateFee, true));
+        emit ToolListed(toolId, msg.sender, name);
+    }
+
+    function updateTool(uint256 toolId, string calldata photoURI, string calldata condition, bool available) external {
+        Tool storage tool = _tool(toolId);
+        if (tool.owner != msg.sender) revert Unauthorized();
+        if (bytes(photoURI).length == 0) revert InvalidInput();
+        tool.photoURI = photoURI;
+        tool.condition = condition;
+        tool.available = available;
+        emit ToolUpdated(toolId);
+    }
+
+    function requestLoan(uint256 toolId, uint32 daysToBorrow) external onlyMember nonReentrant returns (uint256 requestId) {
+        Tool storage tool = _tool(toolId);
+        if (!tool.available || tool.owner == msg.sender || daysToBorrow == 0 || daysToBorrow > 30) revert InvalidInput();
+        uint64 dueAt = uint64(block.timestamp + uint256(daysToBorrow) * 1 days);
+        requestId = requests.length;
+        requests.push(LoanRequest(toolId, msg.sender, uint64(block.timestamp), dueAt, 0, tool.deposit, RequestState.Pending));
+        if (!usdc.transferFrom(msg.sender, address(this), tool.deposit)) revert TransferFailed();
+        emit LoanRequested(requestId, toolId, msg.sender, dueAt);
+    }
+
+    function approveRequest(uint256 requestId) external {
+        LoanRequest storage loan = _request(requestId);
+        Tool storage tool = _tool(loan.toolId);
+        if (tool.owner != msg.sender) revert Unauthorized();
+        if (loan.state != RequestState.Pending || !tool.available) revert InvalidState();
+        loan.state = RequestState.Active;
+        tool.available = false;
+        emit LoanApproved(requestId);
+    }
+
+    function rejectRequest(uint256 requestId) external {
+        LoanRequest storage loan = _request(requestId);
+        if (_tool(loan.toolId).owner != msg.sender) revert Unauthorized();
+        if (loan.state != RequestState.Pending) revert InvalidState();
+        loan.state = RequestState.Rejected;
+        credits[loan.borrower] += loan.deposit;
+        emit RequestClosed(requestId, RequestState.Rejected);
+    }
+
+    function cancelRequest(uint256 requestId) external {
+        LoanRequest storage loan = _request(requestId);
+        if (loan.borrower != msg.sender) revert Unauthorized();
+        if (loan.state != RequestState.Pending) revert InvalidState();
+        loan.state = RequestState.Cancelled;
+        credits[loan.borrower] += loan.deposit;
+        emit RequestClosed(requestId, RequestState.Cancelled);
+    }
+
+    /// @notice The owner confirms the physical tool is back and closes escrow.
+    function confirmReturn(uint256 requestId) external {
+        LoanRequest storage loan = _request(requestId);
+        Tool storage tool = _tool(loan.toolId);
+        if (tool.owner != msg.sender) revert Unauthorized();
+        if (loan.state != RequestState.Active) revert InvalidState();
+
+        uint256 fee;
+        if (block.timestamp > loan.dueAt) {
+            uint256 lateDays = (block.timestamp - loan.dueAt + 1 days - 1) / 1 days;
+            fee = lateDays * uint256(tool.dailyLateFee);
+            if (fee > loan.deposit) fee = loan.deposit;
+            reputations[loan.borrower].lateReturns += 1;
+        }
+        reputations[loan.borrower].completedLoans += 1;
+        loan.returnedAt = uint64(block.timestamp);
+        loan.state = RequestState.Returned;
+        tool.available = true;
+        credits[tool.owner] += fee;
+        credits[loan.borrower] += uint256(loan.deposit) - fee;
+        emit LoanClosed(requestId, fee, uint256(loan.deposit) - fee);
+    }
+
+    function withdraw() external nonReentrant {
+        uint256 amount = credits[msg.sender];
+        if (amount == 0) revert InvalidState();
+        credits[msg.sender] = 0;
+        if (!usdc.transfer(msg.sender, amount)) revert TransferFailed();
+        emit Withdrawal(msg.sender, amount);
+    }
+
+    /// @notice Higher is better; clients sort request candidates descending by this score.
+    function reliabilityScore(address member) external view returns (uint256) {
+        Reputation memory r = reputations[member];
+        if (r.completedLoans == 0) return 5000; // neutral 50.00% prior
+        return uint256(r.completedLoans - r.lateReturns) * 10_000 / r.completedLoans;
+    }
+
+    function toolCount() external view returns (uint256) { return tools.length; }
+    function requestCount() external view returns (uint256) { return requests.length; }
+    function getTool(uint256 toolId) external view returns (Tool memory) { return _tool(toolId); }
+    function getRequest(uint256 requestId) external view returns (LoanRequest memory) { return _request(requestId); }
+
+    function _tool(uint256 id) internal view returns (Tool storage item) {
+        if (id >= tools.length) revert InvalidInput();
+        return tools[id];
+    }
+
+    function _request(uint256 id) internal view returns (LoanRequest storage item) {
+        if (id >= requests.length) revert InvalidInput();
+        return requests[id];
+    }
+}
+
diff --git a/artifacts/ship-goal-001/2026-08-24T202707Z-codex-no-skill-2/workspace/src/web/main.ts b/artifacts/ship-goal-001/2026-08-24T202707Z-codex-no-skill-2/workspace/src/web/main.ts
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..62ad9d31325e1c8f199f8398f7b55e596d557b0f
--- /dev/null
+++ b/artifacts/ship-goal-001/2026-08-24T202707Z-codex-no-skill-2/workspace/src/web/main.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,77 @@
+import { BrowserProvider, Contract, formatUnits, parseUnits } from "ethers";
+import "./style.css";
+
+const ADDRESS = import.meta.env.VITE_TOOLSHED_ADDRESS as string | undefined;
+const ABI = [
+  "function toolCount() view returns (uint256)",
+  "function getTool(uint256) view returns ((address owner,string name,string photoURI,string condition,uint96 deposit,uint96 dailyLateFee,bool available))",
+  "function reliabilityScore(address) view returns (uint256)",
+  "function listTool(string,string,string,uint96,uint96) returns (uint256)",
+  "function requestLoan(uint256,uint32) returns (uint256)",
+  "function usdc() view returns (address)",
+];
+const ERC20_ABI = ["function approve(address,uint256) returns (bool)"];
+type Tool = { id: number; owner: string; name: string; photoURI: string; condition: string; deposit: bigint; dailyLateFee: bigint; score: bigint };
+let provider: BrowserProvider | undefined;
+let contract: Contract | undefined;
+const status = document.querySelector<HTMLParagraphElement>("#status")!;
+const grid = document.querySelector<HTMLDivElement>("#tools")!;
+
+function requireAddress() { if (!ADDRESS) throw new Error("Set VITE_TOOLSHED_ADDRESS in .env.local"); }
+async function connect() {
+  requireAddress();
+  if (!("ethereum" in window)) throw new Error("Install a browser wallet");
+  provider = new BrowserProvider((window as Window & { ethereum: unknown }).ethereum);
+  await provider.send("eth_requestAccounts", []);
+  contract = new Contract(ADDRESS!, ABI, await provider.getSigner());
+  const account = await (await provider.getSigner()).getAddress();
+  document.querySelector<HTMLButtonElement>("#connect")!.textContent = `${account.slice(0, 6)}…${account.slice(-4)}`;
+  await loadTools();
+}
+
+async function loadTools() {
+  if (!contract) return;
+  status.textContent = "Loading neighborhood tools…";
+  const count = Number(await contract.toolCount());
+  const rows = await Promise.all(Array.from({ length: count }, async (_, id) => {
+    const t = await contract!.getTool(id);
+    if (!t.available) return undefined;
+    return { id, owner: t.owner, name: t.name, photoURI: t.photoURI, condition: t.condition, deposit: t.deposit, dailyLateFee: t.dailyLateFee, score: await contract!.reliabilityScore(t.owner) } as Tool;
+  }));
+  const tools = rows.filter((x): x is Tool => Boolean(x)).sort((a, b) => Number(b.score - a.score));
+  grid.replaceChildren(...tools.map(toolCard));
+  status.textContent = tools.length ? "" : "No tools are available yet.";
+}
+
+function toolCard(tool: Tool) {
+  const article = document.createElement("article");
+  const safeImage = tool.photoURI.startsWith("ipfs://") ? `https://ipfs.io/ipfs/${tool.photoURI.slice(7)}` : tool.photoURI;
+  article.innerHTML = `<img alt="Photo of ${escapeHtml(tool.name)}" src="${escapeHtml(safeImage)}"><div class="card-body"><span class="score">${Number(tool.score) / 100}% reliable</span><h3>${escapeHtml(tool.name)}</h3><p>${escapeHtml(tool.condition)}</p><dl><div><dt>Deposit</dt><dd>${formatUnits(tool.deposit, 6)} USDC</dd></div><div><dt>Late fee</dt><dd>${formatUnits(tool.dailyLateFee, 6)} / day</dd></div></dl><label>Days <input class="days" type="number" value="3" min="1" max="30"></label><button class="borrow">Request to borrow</button></div>`;
+  article.querySelector<HTMLButtonElement>(".borrow")!.onclick = async () => {
+    if (!contract) return;
+    const days = Number(article.querySelector<HTMLInputElement>(".days")!.value);
+    try {
+      status.textContent = "Approving USDC deposit…";
+      const token = new Contract(await contract.usdc(), ERC20_ABI, await provider!.getSigner());
+      await (await token.approve(ADDRESS, tool.deposit)).wait();
+      status.textContent = "Submitting request…";
+      await (await contract.requestLoan(tool.id, days)).wait();
+      status.textContent = "Request sent. The owner can now approve it.";
+    } catch (error) { status.textContent = error instanceof Error ? error.message : "Request failed"; }
+  };
+  return article;
+}
+
+function escapeHtml(value: string) { const node = document.createElement("span"); node.textContent = value; return node.innerHTML; }
+document.querySelector("#connect")!.addEventListener("click", () => connect().catch(e => status.textContent = e.message));
+document.querySelector("#show-list-form")!.addEventListener("click", () => document.querySelector<HTMLFormElement>("#list-form")!.hidden = false);
+document.querySelector<HTMLFormElement>("#list-form")!.addEventListener("submit", async event => {
+  event.preventDefault();
+  if (!contract) return void (status.textContent = "Connect your wallet first.");
+  const data = new FormData(event.currentTarget);
+  try {
+    const tx = await contract.listTool(data.get("name"), data.get("photo"), data.get("condition"), parseUnits(String(data.get("deposit")), 6), parseUnits(String(data.get("fee")), 6));
+    status.textContent = "Publishing tool…"; await tx.wait(); event.currentTarget.reset(); event.currentTarget.hidden = true; await loadTools();
+  } catch (error) { status.textContent = error instanceof Error ? error.message : "Listing failed"; }
+});
+

diff --git a/artifacts/ship-goal-001/2026-08-24T202707Z-codex-no-skill-2/workspace/test/Toolshed.t.sol b/artifacts/ship-goal-001/2026-08-24T202707Z-codex-no-skill-2/workspace/test/Toolshed.t.sol
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..9d738abd7aeae1c268d25deceb480fb0532f890e
--- /dev/null
+++ b/artifacts/ship-goal-001/2026-08-24T202707Z-codex-no-skill-2/workspace/test/Toolshed.t.sol
@@ -0,0 +1,105 @@
+// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
+pragma solidity ^0.8.24;
+
+import {Toolshed} from "../src/contracts/Toolshed.sol";
+import {MockUSDC} from "../src/contracts/MockUSDC.sol";
+
+interface Vm {
+    function prank(address) external;
+    function warp(uint256) external;
+    function expectRevert(bytes4) external;
+}
+
+contract ToolshedTest {
+    Vm private constant vm = Vm(address(uint160(uint256(keccak256("hevm cheat code")))));
+    address private constant OWNER = address(0xA11CE);
+    address private constant BORROWER = address(0xB0B);
+    address private constant OUTSIDER = address(0xBAD);
+    MockUSDC private token;
+    Toolshed private shed;
+
+    function setUp() public {
+        token = new MockUSDC();
+        shed = new Toolshed(address(token), address(this));
+        shed.setMember(OWNER, true);
+        shed.setMember(BORROWER, true);
+        token.mint(BORROWER, 1_000e6);
+        vm.prank(BORROWER);
+        token.approve(address(shed), type(uint256).max);
+        vm.prank(OWNER);
+        shed.listTool("Cordless drill", "ipfs://photo", "Good; includes two batteries", 100e6, 10e6);
+    }
+
+    function testOnTimeReturnRefundsFullDeposit() public {
+        uint256 id = _requestAndApprove(3);
+        vm.warp(block.timestamp + 2 days);
+        vm.prank(OWNER);
+        shed.confirmReturn(id);
+
+        (uint32 completed, uint32 late) = shed.reputations(BORROWER);
+        _assertEq(completed, 1);
+        _assertEq(late, 0);
+        _assertEq(shed.credits(BORROWER), 100e6);
+        _assertEq(shed.credits(OWNER), 0);
+        vm.prank(BORROWER);
+        shed.withdraw();
+        _assertEq(token.balanceOf(BORROWER), 1_000e6);
+    }
+
+    function testPartialDayLateRoundsUpAndPaysOwner() public {
+        uint256 id = _requestAndApprove(1);
+        vm.warp(block.timestamp + 1 days + 1);
+        vm.prank(OWNER);
+        shed.confirmReturn(id);
+
+        _assertEq(shed.credits(BORROWER), 90e6);
+        _assertEq(shed.credits(OWNER), 10e6);
+        (uint32 completed, uint32 late) = shed.reputations(BORROWER);
+        _assertEq(completed, 1);
+        _assertEq(late, 1);
+        _assertEq(shed.reliabilityScore(BORROWER), 0);
+    }
+
+    function testLateFeeCannotExceedDeposit() public {
+        uint256 id = _requestAndApprove(1);
+        vm.warp(block.timestamp + 100 days);
+        vm.prank(OWNER);
+        shed.confirmReturn(id);
+        _assertEq(shed.credits(BORROWER), 0);
+        _assertEq(shed.credits(OWNER), 100e6);
+    }
+
+    function testCancelReturnsEscrowAsWithdrawableCredit() public {
+        vm.prank(BORROWER);
+        uint256 id = shed.requestLoan(0, 2);
+        vm.prank(BORROWER);
+        shed.cancelRequest(id);
+        _assertEq(shed.credits(BORROWER), 100e6);
+        Toolshed.LoanRequest memory loan = shed.getRequest(id);
+        _assertEq(uint256(loan.state), uint256(Toolshed.RequestState.Cancelled));
+    }
+
+    function testOnlyOwnerCanConfirmPhysicalReturn() public {
+        uint256 id = _requestAndApprove(1);
+        vm.expectRevert(Toolshed.Unauthorized.selector);
+        vm.prank(BORROWER);
+        shed.confirmReturn(id);
+    }
+
+    function testNonMemberCannotRequest() public {
+        token.mint(OUTSIDER, 100e6);
+        vm.expectRevert(Toolshed.NotMember.selector);
+        vm.prank(OUTSIDER);
+        shed.requestLoan(0, 1);
+    }
+
+    function _requestAndApprove(uint32 daysToBorrow) private returns (uint256 id) {
+        vm.prank(BORROWER);
+        id = shed.requestLoan(0, daysToBorrow);
+        vm.prank(OWNER);
+        shed.approveRequest(id);
+    }
+
+    function _assertEq(uint256 actual, uint256 expected) private pure { require(actual == expected, "not equal"); }
+}
+

--- /dev/null
+++ b/artifacts/ship-goal-001/2026-08-24T202707Z-codex-no-skill-2/workspace/src/contracts/MockUSDC.sol
@@ -0,0 +1,26 @@
+// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
+pragma solidity ^0.8.24;
+
+contract MockUSDC {
+    string public constant name = "Mock USDC";
+    string public constant symbol = "USDC";
+    uint8 public constant decimals = 6;
+    mapping(address => uint256) public balanceOf;
+    mapping(address => mapping(address => uint256)) public allowance;
+
+    function mint(address to, uint256 amount) external { balanceOf[to] += amount; }
+    function approve(address spender, uint256 amount) external returns (bool) { allowance[msg.sender][spender] = amount; return true; }
+    function transfer(address to, uint256 amount) external returns (bool) { _move(msg.sender, to, amount); return true; }
+    function transferFrom(address from, address to, uint256 amount) external returns (bool) {
+        uint256 approved = allowance[from][msg.sender];
+        require(approved >= amount, "allowance");
+        allowance[from][msg.sender] = approved - amount;
+        _move(from, to, amount);
+        return true;
+    }
+    function _move(address from, address to, uint256 amount) private {
+        require(balanceOf[from] >= amount, "balance");
+        balanceOf[from] -= amount;
+        balanceOf[to] += amount;
+    }
+}
diff --git a/artifacts/ship-goal-001/2026-08-24T202707Z-codex-no-skill-2/workspace/src/contracts/Toolshed.sol b/artifacts/ship-goal-001/2026-08-24T202707Z-codex-no-skill-2/workspace/src/contracts/Toolshed.sol
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..8c722c46875e7e57b5c52d5fb538a83a1cfa2286
--- /dev/null
+++ b/artifacts/ship-goal-001/2026-08-24T202707Z-codex-no-skill-2/workspace/src/contracts/Toolshed.sol
@@ -0,0 +1,203 @@
+// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
+pragma solidity ^0.8.24;
+
+interface IERC20 {
+    function transfer(address to, uint256 amount) external returns (bool);
+    function transferFrom(address from, address to, uint256 amount) external returns (bool);
+}
+
+/// @title Toolshed - member-managed physical tool lending with USDC escrow.
+contract Toolshed {
+    enum RequestState { Pending, Active, Returned, Cancelled, Rejected }
+
+    struct Reputation {
+        uint32 completedLoans;
+        uint32 lateReturns;
+    }
+
+    struct Tool {
+        address owner;
+        string name;
+        string photoURI;
+        string condition;
+        uint96 deposit;
+        uint96 dailyLateFee;
+        bool available;
+    }
+
+    struct LoanRequest {
+        uint256 toolId;
+        address borrower;
+        uint64 requestedAt;
+        uint64 dueAt;
+        uint64 returnedAt;
+        uint96 deposit;
+        RequestState state;
+    }
+
+    error Unauthorized();
+    error NotMember();
+    error InvalidInput();
+    error InvalidState();
+    error TransferFailed();
+    error Reentrancy();
+
+    event MembershipSet(address indexed member, bool allowed);
+    event ToolListed(uint256 indexed toolId, address indexed owner, string name);
+    event ToolUpdated(uint256 indexed toolId);
+    event LoanRequested(uint256 indexed requestId, uint256 indexed toolId, address indexed borrower, uint64 dueAt);
+    event LoanApproved(uint256 indexed requestId);
+    event LoanClosed(uint256 indexed requestId, uint256 lateFee, uint256 refund);
+    event RequestClosed(uint256 indexed requestId, RequestState state);
+    event Withdrawal(address indexed account, uint256 amount);
+
+    address public immutable administrator;
+    IERC20 public immutable usdc;
+    mapping(address => bool) public members;
+    mapping(address => Reputation) public reputations;
+    mapping(address => uint256) public credits;
+    Tool[] private tools;
+    LoanRequest[] private requests;
+    uint256 private unlocked = 1;
+
+    modifier onlyAdmin() { if (msg.sender != administrator) revert Unauthorized(); _; }
+    modifier onlyMember() { if (!members[msg.sender]) revert NotMember(); _; }
+    modifier nonReentrant() { if (unlocked != 1) revert Reentrancy(); unlocked = 2; _; unlocked = 1; }
+
+    constructor(address usdcAddress, address admin) {
+        if (usdcAddress == address(0) || admin == address(0)) revert InvalidInput();
+        usdc = IERC20(usdcAddress);
+        administrator = admin;
+    }
+
+    function setMember(address member, bool allowed) external onlyAdmin {
+        if (member == address(0)) revert InvalidInput();
+        members[member] = allowed;
+        emit MembershipSet(member, allowed);
+    }
+
+    function setMembers(address[] calldata accounts, bool allowed) external onlyAdmin {
+        for (uint256 i; i < accounts.length; ++i) {
+            if (accounts[i] == address(0)) revert InvalidInput();
+            members[accounts[i]] = allowed;
+            emit MembershipSet(accounts[i], allowed);
+        }
+    }
+
+    function listTool(
+        string calldata name,
+        string calldata photoURI,
+        string calldata condition,
+        uint96 deposit,
+        uint96 dailyLateFee
+    ) external onlyMember returns (uint256 toolId) {
+        if (bytes(name).length == 0 || bytes(photoURI).length == 0 || deposit == 0 || dailyLateFee > deposit) {
+            revert InvalidInput();
+        }
+        toolId = tools.length;
+        tools.push(Tool(msg.sender, name, photoURI, condition, deposit, dailyLateFee, true));
+        emit ToolListed(toolId, msg.sender, name);
+    }
+
+    function updateTool(uint256 toolId, string calldata photoURI, string calldata condition, bool available) external {
+        Tool storage tool = _tool(toolId);
+        if (tool.owner != msg.sender) revert Unauthorized();
+        if (bytes(photoURI).length == 0) revert InvalidInput();
+        tool.photoURI = photoURI;
+        tool.condition = condition;
+        tool.available = available;
+        emit ToolUpdated(toolId);
+    }
+
+    function requestLoan(uint256 toolId, uint32 daysToBorrow) external onlyMember nonReentrant returns (uint256 requestId) {
+        Tool storage tool = _tool(toolId);
+        if (!tool.available || tool.owner == msg.sender || daysToBorrow == 0 || daysToBorrow > 30) revert InvalidInput();
+        uint64 dueAt = uint64(block.timestamp + uint256(daysToBorrow) * 1 days);
+        requestId = requests.length;
+        requests.push(LoanRequest(toolId, msg.sender, uint64(block.timestamp), dueAt, 0, tool.deposit, RequestState.Pending));
+        if (!usdc.transferFrom(msg.sender, address(this), tool.deposit)) revert TransferFailed();
+        emit LoanRequested(requestId, toolId, msg.sender, dueAt);
+    }
+
+    function approveRequest(uint256 requestId) external {
+        LoanRequest storage loan = _request(requestId);
+        Tool storage tool = _tool(loan.toolId);
+        if (tool.owner != msg.sender) revert Unauthorized();
+        if (loan.state != RequestState.Pending || !tool.available) revert InvalidState();
+        loan.state = RequestState.Active;
+        tool.available = false;
+        emit LoanApproved(requestId);
+    }
+
+    function rejectRequest(uint256 requestId) external {
+        LoanRequest storage loan = _request(requestId);
+        if (_tool(loan.toolId).owner != msg.sender) revert Unauthorized();
+        if (loan.state != RequestState.Pending) revert InvalidState();
+        loan.state = RequestState.Rejected;
+        credits[loan.borrower] += loan.deposit;
+        emit RequestClosed(requestId, RequestState.Rejected);
+    }
+
+    function cancelRequest(uint256 requestId) external {
+        LoanRequest storage loan = _request(requestId);
+        if (loan.borrower != msg.sender) revert Unauthorized();
+        if (loan.state != RequestState.Pending) revert InvalidState();
+        loan.state = RequestState.Cancelled;
+        credits[loan.borrower] += loan.deposit;
+        emit RequestClosed(requestId, RequestState.Cancelled);
+    }
+
+    /// @notice The owner confirms the physical tool is back and closes escrow.
+    function confirmReturn(uint256 requestId) external {
+        LoanRequest storage loan = _request(requestId);
+        Tool storage tool = _tool(loan.toolId);
+        if (tool.owner != msg.sender) revert Unauthorized();
+        if (loan.state != RequestState.Active) revert InvalidState();
+
+        uint256 fee;
+        if (block.timestamp > loan.dueAt) {
+            uint256 lateDays = (block.timestamp - loan.dueAt + 1 days - 1) / 1 days;
+            fee = lateDays * uint256(tool.dailyLateFee);
+            if (fee > loan.deposit) fee = loan.deposit;
+            reputations[loan.borrower].lateReturns += 1;
+        }
+        reputations[loan.borrower].completedLoans += 1;
+        loan.returnedAt = uint64(block.timestamp);
+        loan.state = RequestState.Returned;
+        tool.available = true;
+        credits[tool.owner] += fee;
+        credits[loan.borrower] += uint256(loan.deposit) - fee;
+        emit LoanClosed(requestId, fee, uint256(loan.deposit) - fee);
+    }
+
+    function withdraw() external nonReentrant {
+        uint256 amount = credits[msg.sender];
+        if (amount == 0) revert InvalidState();
+        credits[msg.sender] = 0;
+        if (!usdc.transfer(msg.sender, amount)) revert TransferFailed();
+        emit Withdrawal(msg.sender, amount);
+    }
+
+    /// @notice Higher is better; clients sort request candidates descending by this score.
+    function reliabilityScore(address member) external view returns (uint256) {
+        Reputation memory r = reputations[member];
+        if (r.completedLoans == 0) return 5000; // neutral 50.00% prior
+        return uint256(r.completedLoans - r.lateReturns) * 10_000 / r.completedLoans;
+    }
+
+    function toolCount() external view returns (uint256) { return tools.length; }
+    function requestCount() external view returns (uint256) { return requests.length; }
+    function getTool(uint256 toolId) external view returns (Tool memory) { return _tool(toolId); }
+    function getRequest(uint256 requestId) external view returns (LoanRequest memory) { return _request(requestId); }
+
+    function _tool(uint256 id) internal view returns (Tool storage item) {
+        if (id >= tools.length) revert InvalidInput();
+        return tools[id];
+    }
+
+    function _request(uint256 id) internal view returns (LoanRequest storage item) {
+        if (id >= requests.length) revert InvalidInput();
+        return requests[id];
+    }
+}
+
diff --git a/artifacts/ship-goal-001/2026-08-24T202707Z-codex-no-skill-2/workspace/src/web/main.ts b/artifacts/ship-goal-001/2026-08-24T202707Z-codex-no-skill-2/workspace/src/web/main.ts
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..62ad9d31325e1c8f199f8398f7b55e596d557b0f
--- /dev/null
+++ b/artifacts/ship-goal-001/2026-08-24T202707Z-codex-no-skill-2/workspace/src/web/main.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,77 @@
+import { BrowserProvider, Contract, formatUnits, parseUnits } from "ethers";
+import "./style.css";
+
+const ADDRESS = import.meta.env.VITE_TOOLSHED_ADDRESS as string | undefined;
+const ABI = [
+  "function toolCount() view returns (uint256)",
+  "function getTool(uint256) view returns ((address owner,string name,string photoURI,string condition,uint96 deposit,uint96 dailyLateFee,bool available))",
+  "function reliabilityScore(address) view returns (uint256)",
+  "function listTool(string,string,string,uint96,uint96) returns (uint256)",
+  "function requestLoan(uint256,uint32) returns (uint256)",
+  "function usdc() view returns (address)",
+];
+const ERC20_ABI = ["function approve(address,uint256) returns (bool)"];
+type Tool = { id: number; owner: string; name: string; photoURI: string; condition: string; deposit: bigint; dailyLateFee: bigint; score: bigint };
+let provider: BrowserProvider | undefined;
+let contract: Contract | undefined;
+const status = document.querySelector<HTMLParagraphElement>("#status")!;
+const grid = document.querySelector<HTMLDivElement>("#tools")!;
+
+function requireAddress() { if (!ADDRESS) throw new Error("Set VITE_TOOLSHED_ADDRESS in .env.local"); }
+async function connect() {
+  requireAddress();
+  if (!("ethereum" in window)) throw new Error("Install a browser wallet");
+  provider = new BrowserProvider((window as Window & { ethereum: unknown }).ethereum);
+  await provider.send("eth_requestAccounts", []);
+  contract = new Contract(ADDRESS!, ABI, await provider.getSigner());
+  const account = await (await provider.getSigner()).getAddress();
+  document.querySelector<HTMLButtonElement>("#connect")!.textContent = `${account.slice(0, 6)}…${account.slice(-4)}`;
+  await loadTools();
+}
+
+async function loadTools() {
+  if (!contract) return;
+  status.textContent = "Loading neighborhood tools…";
+  const count = Number(await contract.toolCount());
+  const rows = await Promise.all(Array.from({ length: count }, async (_, id) => {
+    const t = await contract!.getTool(id);
+    if (!t.available) return undefined;
+    return { id, owner: t.owner, name: t.name, photoURI: t.photoURI, condition: t.condition, deposit: t.deposit, dailyLateFee: t.dailyLateFee, score: await contract!.reliabilityScore(t.owner) } as Tool;
+  }));
+  const tools = rows.filter((x): x is Tool => Boolean(x)).sort((a, b) => Number(b.score - a.score));
+  grid.replaceChildren(...tools.map(toolCard));
+  status.textContent = tools.length ? "" : "No tools are available yet.";
+}
+
+function toolCard(tool: Tool) {
+  const article = document.createElement("article");
+  const safeImage = tool.photoURI.startsWith("ipfs://") ? `https://ipfs.io/ipfs/${tool.photoURI.slice(7)}` : tool.photoURI;
+  article.innerHTML = `<img alt="Photo of ${escapeHtml(tool.name)}" src="${escapeHtml(safeImage)}"><div class="card-body"><span class="score">${Number(tool.score) / 100}% reliable</span><h3>${escapeHtml(tool.name)}</h3><p>${escapeHtml(tool.condition)}</p><dl><div><dt>Deposit</dt><dd>${formatUnits(tool.deposit, 6)} USDC</dd></div><div><dt>Late fee</dt><dd>${formatUnits(tool.dailyLateFee, 6)} / day</dd></div></dl><label>Days <input class="days" type="number" value="3" min="1" max="30"></label><button class="borrow">Request to borrow</button></div>`;
+  article.querySelector<HTMLButtonElement>(".borrow")!.onclick = async () => {
+    if (!contract) return;
+    const days = Number(article.querySelector<HTMLInputElement>(".days")!.value);
+    try {
+      status.textContent = "Approving USDC deposit…";
+      const token = new Contract(await contract.usdc(), ERC20_ABI, await provider!.getSigner());
+      await (await token.approve(ADDRESS, tool.deposit)).wait();
+      status.textContent = "Submitting request…";
+      await (await contract.requestLoan(tool.id, days)).wait();
+      status.textContent = "Request sent. The owner can now approve it.";
+    } catch (error) { status.textContent = error instanceof Error ? error.message : "Request failed"; }
+  };
+  return article;
+}
+
+function escapeHtml(value: string) { const node = document.createElement("span"); node.textContent = value; return node.innerHTML; }
+document.querySelector("#connect")!.addEventListener("click", () => connect().catch(e => status.textContent = e.message));
+document.querySelector("#show-list-form")!.addEventListener("click", () => document.querySelector<HTMLFormElement>("#list-form")!.hidden = false);
+document.querySelector<HTMLFormElement>("#list-form")!.addEventListener("submit", async event => {
+  event.preventDefault();
+  if (!contract) return void (status.textContent = "Connect your wallet first.");
+  const data = new FormData(event.currentTarget);
+  try {
+    const tx = await contract.listTool(data.get("name"), data.get("photo"), data.get("condition"), parseUnits(String(data.get("deposit")), 6), parseUnits(String(data.get("fee")), 6));
+    status.textContent = "Publishing tool…"; await tx.wait(); event.currentTarget.reset(); event.currentTarget.hidden = true; await loadTools();
+  } catch (error) { status.textContent = error instanceof Error ? error.message : "Listing failed"; }
+});
+

index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..9d738abd7aeae1c268d25deceb480fb0532f890e
--- /dev/null
+++ b/artifacts/ship-goal-001/2026-08-24T202707Z-codex-no-skill-2/workspace/test/Toolshed.t.sol
@@ -0,0 +1,105 @@
+// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
+pragma solidity ^0.8.24;
+
+import {Toolshed} from "../src/contracts/Toolshed.sol";
+import {MockUSDC} from "../src/contracts/MockUSDC.sol";
+
+interface Vm {
+    function prank(address) external;
+    function warp(uint256) external;
+    function expectRevert(bytes4) external;
+}
+
+contract ToolshedTest {
+    Vm private constant vm = Vm(address(uint160(uint256(keccak256("hevm cheat code")))));
+    address private constant OWNER = address(0xA11CE);
+    address private constant BORROWER = address(0xB0B);
+    address private constant OUTSIDER = address(0xBAD);
+    MockUSDC private token;
+    Toolshed private shed;
+
+    function setUp() public {
+        token = new MockUSDC();
+        shed = new Toolshed(address(token), address(this));
+        shed.setMember(OWNER, true);
+        shed.setMember(BORROWER, true);
+        token.mint(BORROWER, 1_000e6);
+        vm.prank(BORROWER);
+        token.approve(address(shed), type(uint256).max);
+        vm.prank(OWNER);
+        shed.listTool("Cordless drill", "ipfs://photo", "Good; includes two batteries", 100e6, 10e6);
+    }
+
+    function testOnTimeReturnRefundsFullDeposit() public {
+        uint256 id = _requestAndApprove(3);
+        vm.warp(block.timestamp + 2 days);
+        vm.prank(OWNER);
+        shed.confirmReturn(id);
+
+        (uint32 completed, uint32 late) = shed.reputations(BORROWER);
+        _assertEq(completed, 1);
+        _assertEq(late, 0);
+        _assertEq(shed.credits(BORROWER), 100e6);
+        _assertEq(shed.credits(OWNER), 0);
+        vm.prank(BORROWER);
+        shed.withdraw();
+        _assertEq(token.balanceOf(BORROWER), 1_000e6);
+    }
+
+    function testPartialDayLateRoundsUpAndPaysOwner() public {
+        uint256 id = _requestAndApprove(1);
+        vm.warp(block.timestamp + 1 days + 1);
+        vm.prank(OWNER);
+        shed.confirmReturn(id);
+
+        _assertEq(shed.credits(BORROWER), 90e6);
+        _assertEq(shed.credits(OWNER), 10e6);
+        (uint32 completed, uint32 late) = shed.reputations(BORROWER);
+        _assertEq(completed, 1);
+        _assertEq(late, 1);
+        _assertEq(shed.reliabilityScore(BORROWER), 0);
+    }
+
+    function testLateFeeCannotExceedDeposit() public {
+        uint256 id = _requestAndApprove(1);
+        vm.warp(block.timestamp + 100 days);
+        vm.prank(OWNER);
+        shed.confirmReturn(id);
+        _assertEq(shed.credits(BORROWER), 0);
+        _assertEq(shed.credits(OWNER), 100e6);
+    }
+
+    function testCancelReturnsEscrowAsWithdrawableCredit() public {
+        vm.prank(BORROWER);
+        uint256 id = shed.requestLoan(0, 2);
+        vm.prank(BORROWER);
+        shed.cancelRequest(id);
+        _assertEq(shed.credits(BORROWER), 100e6);
+        Toolshed.LoanRequest memory loan = shed.getRequest(id);
+        _assertEq(uint256(loan.state), uint256(Toolshed.RequestState.Cancelled));
+    }
+
+    function testOnlyOwnerCanConfirmPhysicalReturn() public {
+        uint256 id = _requestAndApprove(1);
+        vm.expectRevert(Toolshed.Unauthorized.selector);
+        vm.prank(BORROWER);
+        shed.confirmReturn(id);
+    }
+
+    function testNonMemberCannotRequest() public {
+        token.mint(OUTSIDER, 100e6);
+        vm.expectRevert(Toolshed.NotMember.selector);
+        vm.prank(OUTSIDER);
+        shed.requestLoan(0, 1);
+    }
+
+    function _requestAndApprove(uint32 daysToBorrow) private returns (uint256 id) {
+        vm.prank(BORROWER);
+        id = shed.requestLoan(0, daysToBorrow);
+        vm.prank(OWNER);
+        shed.approveRequest(id);
+    }
+
+    function _assertEq(uint256 actual, uint256 expected) private pure { require(actual == expected, "not equal"); }
+}
+

@@ -0,0 +1,26 @@
+// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
+pragma solidity ^0.8.24;
+
+contract MockUSDC {
+    string public constant name = "Mock USDC";
+    string public constant symbol = "USDC";
+    uint8 public constant decimals = 6;
+    mapping(address => uint256) public balanceOf;
+    mapping(address => mapping(address => uint256)) public allowance;
+
+    function mint(address to, uint256 amount) external { balanceOf[to] += amount; }
+    function approve(address spender, uint256 amount) external returns (bool) { allowance[msg.sender][spender] = amount; return true; }
+    function transfer(address to, uint256 amount) external returns (bool) { _move(msg.sender, to, amount); return true; }
+    function transferFrom(address from, address to, uint256 amount) external returns (bool) {
+        uint256 approved = allowance[from][msg.sender];
+        require(approved >= amount, "allowance");
+        allowance[from][msg.sender] = approved - amount;
+        _move(from, to, amount);
+        return true;
+    }
+    function _move(address from, address to, uint256 amount) private {
+        require(balanceOf[from] >= amount, "balance");
+        balanceOf[from] -= amount;
+        balanceOf[to] += amount;
+    }
+}
diff --git a/artifacts/ship-goal-001/2026-08-24T202707Z-codex-no-skill-2/workspace/src/contracts/Toolshed.sol b/artifacts/ship-goal-001/2026-08-24T202707Z-codex-no-skill-2/workspace/src/contracts/Toolshed.sol
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..8c722c46875e7e57b5c52d5fb538a83a1cfa2286
--- /dev/null
+++ b/artifacts/ship-goal-001/2026-08-24T202707Z-codex-no-skill-2/workspace/src/contracts/Toolshed.sol
@@ -0,0 +1,203 @@
+// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
+pragma solidity ^0.8.24;
+
+interface IERC20 {
+    function transfer(address to, uint256 amount) external returns (bool);
+    function transferFrom(address from, address to, uint256 amount) external returns (bool);
+}
+
+/// @title Toolshed - member-managed physical tool lending with USDC escrow.
+contract Toolshed {
+    enum RequestState { Pending, Active, Returned, Cancelled, Rejected }
+
+    struct Reputation {
+        uint32 completedLoans;
+        uint32 lateReturns;
+    }
+
+    struct Tool {
+        address owner;
+        string name;
+        string photoURI;
+        string condition;
+        uint96 deposit;
+        uint96 dailyLateFee;
+        bool available;
+    }
+
+    struct LoanRequest {
+        uint256 toolId;
+        address borrower;
+        uint64 requestedAt;
+        uint64 dueAt;
+        uint64 returnedAt;
+        uint96 deposit;
+        RequestState state;
+    }
+
+    error Unauthorized();
+    error NotMember();
+    error InvalidInput();
+    error InvalidState();
+    error TransferFailed();
+    error Reentrancy();
+
+    event MembershipSet(address indexed member, bool allowed);
+    event ToolListed(uint256 indexed toolId, address indexed owner, string name);
+    event ToolUpdated(uint256 indexed toolId);
+    event LoanRequested(uint256 indexed requestId, uint256 indexed toolId, address indexed borrower, uint64 dueAt);
+    event LoanApproved(uint256 indexed requestId);
+    event LoanClosed(uint256 indexed requestId, uint256 lateFee, uint256 refund);
+    event RequestClosed(uint256 indexed requestId, RequestState state);
+    event Withdrawal(address indexed account, uint256 amount);
+
+    address public immutable administrator;
+    IERC20 public immutable usdc;
+    mapping(address => bool) public members;
+    mapping(address => Reputation) public reputations;
+    mapping(address => uint256) public credits;
+    Tool[] private tools;
+    LoanRequest[] private requests;
+    uint256 private unlocked = 1;
+
+    modifier onlyAdmin() { if (msg.sender != administrator) revert Unauthorized(); _; }
+    modifier onlyMember() { if (!members[msg.sender]) revert NotMember(); _; }
+    modifier nonReentrant() { if (unlocked != 1) revert Reentrancy(); unlocked = 2; _; unlocked = 1; }
+
+    constructor(address usdcAddress, address admin) {
+        if (usdcAddress == address(0) || admin == address(0)) revert InvalidInput();
+        usdc = IERC20(usdcAddress);
+        administrator = admin;
+    }
+
+    function setMember(address member, bool allowed) external onlyAdmin {
+        if (member == address(0)) revert InvalidInput();
+        members[member] = allowed;
+        emit MembershipSet(member, allowed);
+    }
+
+    function setMembers(address[] calldata accounts, bool allowed) external onlyAdmin {
+        for (uint256 i; i < accounts.length; ++i) {
+            if (accounts[i] == address(0)) revert InvalidInput();
+            members[accounts[i]] = allowed;
+            emit MembershipSet(accounts[i], allowed);
+        }
+    }
+
+    function listTool(
+        string calldata name,
+        string calldata photoURI,
+        string calldata condition,
+        uint96 deposit,
+        uint96 dailyLateFee
+    ) external onlyMember returns (uint256 toolId) {
+        if (bytes(name).length == 0 || bytes(photoURI).length == 0 || deposit == 0 || dailyLateFee > deposit) {
+            revert InvalidInput();
+        }
+        toolId = tools.length;
+        tools.push(Tool(msg.sender, name, photoURI, condition, deposit, dailyLateFee, true));
+        emit ToolListed(toolId, msg.sender, name);
+    }
+
+    function updateTool(uint256 toolId, string calldata photoURI, string calldata condition, bool available) external {
+        Tool storage tool = _tool(toolId);
+        if (tool.owner != msg.sender) revert Unauthorized();
+        if (bytes(photoURI).length == 0) revert InvalidInput();
+        tool.photoURI = photoURI;
+        tool.condition = condition;
+        tool.available = available;
+        emit ToolUpdated(toolId);
+    }
+
+    function requestLoan(uint256 toolId, uint32 daysToBorrow) external onlyMember nonReentrant returns (uint256 requestId) {
+        Tool storage tool = _tool(toolId);
+        if (!tool.available || tool.owner == msg.sender || daysToBorrow == 0 || daysToBorrow > 30) revert InvalidInput();
+        uint64 dueAt = uint64(block.timestamp + uint256(daysToBorrow) * 1 days);
+        requestId = requests.length;
+        requests.push(LoanRequest(toolId, msg.sender, uint64(block.timestamp), dueAt, 0, tool.deposit, RequestState.Pending));
+        if (!usdc.transferFrom(msg.sender, address(this), tool.deposit)) revert TransferFailed();
+        emit LoanRequested(requestId, toolId, msg.sender, dueAt);
+    }
+
+    function approveRequest(uint256 requestId) external {
+        LoanRequest storage loan = _request(requestId);
+        Tool storage tool = _tool(loan.toolId);
+        if (tool.owner != msg.sender) revert Unauthorized();
+        if (loan.state != RequestState.Pending || !tool.available) revert InvalidState();
+        loan.state = RequestState.Active;
+        tool.available = false;
+        emit LoanApproved(requestId);
+    }
+
+    function rejectRequest(uint256 requestId) external {
+        LoanRequest storage loan = _request(requestId);
+        if (_tool(loan.toolId).owner != msg.sender) revert Unauthorized();
+        if (loan.state != RequestState.Pending) revert InvalidState();
+        loan.state = RequestState.Rejected;
+        credits[loan.borrower] += loan.deposit;
+        emit RequestClosed(requestId, RequestState.Rejected);
+    }
+
+    function cancelRequest(uint256 requestId) external {
+        LoanRequest storage loan = _request(requestId);
+        if (loan.borrower != msg.sender) revert Unauthorized();
+        if (loan.state != RequestState.Pending) revert InvalidState();
+        loan.state = RequestState.Cancelled;
+        credits[loan.borrower] += loan.deposit;
+        emit RequestClosed(requestId, RequestState.Cancelled);
+    }
+
+    /// @notice The owner confirms the physical tool is back and closes escrow.
+    function confirmReturn(uint256 requestId) external {
+        LoanRequest storage loan = _request(requestId);
+        Tool storage tool = _tool(loan.toolId);
+        if (tool.owner != msg.sender) revert Unauthorized();
+        if (loan.state != RequestState.Active) revert InvalidState();
+
+        uint256 fee;
+        if (block.timestamp > loan.dueAt) {
+            uint256 lateDays = (block.timestamp - loan.dueAt + 1 days - 1) / 1 days;
+            fee = lateDays * uint256(tool.dailyLateFee);
+            if (fee > loan.deposit) fee = loan.deposit;
+            reputations[loan.borrower].lateReturns += 1;
+        }
+        reputations[loan.borrower].completedLoans += 1;
+        loan.returnedAt = uint64(block.timestamp);
+        loan.state = RequestState.Returned;
+        tool.available = true;
+        credits[tool.owner] += fee;
+        credits[loan.borrower] += uint256(loan.deposit) - fee;
+        emit LoanClosed(requestId, fee, uint256(loan.deposit) - fee);
+    }
+
+    function withdraw() external nonReentrant {
+        uint256 amount = credits[msg.sender];
+        if (amount == 0) revert InvalidState();
+        credits[msg.sender] = 0;
+        if (!usdc.transfer(msg.sender, amount)) revert TransferFailed();
+        emit Withdrawal(msg.sender, amount);
+    }
+
+    /// @notice Higher is better; clients sort request candidates descending by this score.
+    function reliabilityScore(address member) external view returns (uint256) {
+        Reputation memory r = reputations[member];
+        if (r.completedLoans == 0) return 5000; // neutral 50.00% prior
+        return uint256(r.completedLoans - r.lateReturns) * 10_000 / r.completedLoans;
+    }
+
+    function toolCount() external view returns (uint256) { return tools.length; }
+    function requestCount() external view returns (uint256) { return requests.length; }
+    function getTool(uint256 toolId) external view returns (Tool memory) { return _tool(toolId); }
+    function getRequest(uint256 requestId) external view returns (LoanRequest memory) { return _request(requestId); }
+
+    function _tool(uint256 id) internal view returns (Tool storage item) {
+        if (id >= tools.length) revert InvalidInput();
+        return tools[id];
+    }
+
+    function _request(uint256 id) internal view returns (LoanRequest storage item) {
+        if (id >= requests.length) revert InvalidInput();
+        return requests[id];
+    }
+}
+
diff --git a/artifacts/ship-goal-001/2026-08-24T202707Z-codex-no-skill-2/workspace/src/web/main.ts b/artifacts/ship-goal-001/2026-08-24T202707Z-codex-no-skill-2/workspace/src/web/main.ts

index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..62ad9d31325e1c8f199f8398f7b55e596d557b0f

@@ -0,0 +1,77 @@
+import { BrowserProvider, Contract, formatUnits, parseUnits } from "ethers";
+import "./style.css";
+
+const ADDRESS = import.meta.env.VITE_TOOLSHED_ADDRESS as string | undefined;
+const ABI = [
+  "function toolCount() view returns (uint256)",
+  "function getTool(uint256) view returns ((address owner,string name,string photoURI,string condition,uint96 deposit,uint96 dailyLateFee,bool available))",
+  "function reliabilityScore(address) view returns (uint256)",
+  "function listTool(string,string,string,uint96,uint96) returns (uint256)",
+  "function requestLoan(uint256,uint32) returns (uint256)",
+  "function usdc() view returns (address)",
+];
+const ERC20_ABI = ["function approve(address,uint256) returns (bool)"];
+type Tool = { id: number; owner: string; name: string; photoURI: string; condition: string; deposit: bigint; dailyLateFee: bigint; score: bigint };
+let provider: BrowserProvider | undefined;
+let contract: Contract | undefined;
+const status = document.querySelector<HTMLParagraphElement>("#status")!;
+const grid = document.querySelector<HTMLDivElement>("#tools")!;
+
+function requireAddress() { if (!ADDRESS) throw new Error("Set VITE_TOOLSHED_ADDRESS in .env.local"); }
+async function connect() {
+  requireAddress();
+  if (!("ethereum" in window)) throw new Error("Install a browser wallet");
+  provider = new BrowserProvider((window as Window & { ethereum: unknown }).ethereum);
+  await provider.send("eth_requestAccounts", []);
+  contract = new Contract(ADDRESS!, ABI, await provider.getSigner());
+  const account = await (await provider.getSigner()).getAddress();
+  document.querySelector<HTMLButtonElement>("#connect")!.textContent = `${account.slice(0, 6)}…${account.slice(-4)}`;
+  await loadTools();
+}
+
+async function loadTools() {
+  if (!contract) return;
+  status.textContent = "Loading neighborhood tools…";
+  const count = Number(await contract.toolCount());
+  const rows = await Promise.all(Array.from({ length: count }, async (_, id) => {
+    const t = await contract!.getTool(id);
+    if (!t.available) return undefined;
+    return { id, owner: t.owner, name: t.name, photoURI: t.photoURI, condition: t.condition, deposit: t.deposit, dailyLateFee: t.dailyLateFee, score: await contract!.reliabilityScore(t.owner) } as Tool;
+  }));
+  const tools = rows.filter((x): x is Tool => Boolean(x)).sort((a, b) => Number(b.score - a.score));
+  grid.replaceChildren(...tools.map(toolCard));
+  status.textContent = tools.length ? "" : "No tools are available yet.";
+}
+
+function toolCard(tool: Tool) {
+  const article = document.createElement("article");
+  const safeImage = tool.photoURI.startsWith("ipfs://") ? `https://ipfs.io/ipfs/${tool.photoURI.slice(7)}` : tool.photoURI;
+  article.innerHTML = `<img alt="Photo of ${escapeHtml(tool.name)}" src="${escapeHtml(safeImage)}"><div class="card-body"><span class="score">${Number(tool.score) / 100}% reliable</span><h3>${escapeHtml(tool.name)}</h3><p>${escapeHtml(tool.condition)}</p><dl><div><dt>Deposit</dt><dd>${formatUnits(tool.deposit, 6)} USDC</dd></div><div><dt>Late fee</dt><dd>${formatUnits(tool.dailyLateFee, 6)} / day</dd></div></dl><label>Days <input class="days" type="number" value="3" min="1" max="30"></label><button class="borrow">Request to borrow</button></div>`;
+  article.querySelector<HTMLButtonElement>(".borrow")!.onclick = async () => {
+    if (!contract) return;
+    const days = Number(article.querySelector<HTMLInputElement>(".days")!.value);
+    try {
+      status.textContent = "Approving USDC deposit…";
+      const token = new Contract(await contract.usdc(), ERC20_ABI, await provider!.getSigner());
+      await (await token.approve(ADDRESS, tool.deposit)).wait();
+      status.textContent = "Submitting request…";
+      await (await contract.requestLoan(tool.id, days)).wait();
+      status.textContent = "Request sent. The owner can now approve it.";
+    } catch (error) { status.textContent = error instanceof Error ? error.message : "Request failed"; }
+  };
+  return article;
+}
+
+function escapeHtml(value: string) { const node = document.createElement("span"); node.textContent = value; return node.innerHTML; }
+document.querySelector("#connect")!.addEventListener("click", () => connect().catch(e => status.textContent = e.message));
+document.querySelector("#show-list-form")!.addEventListener("click", () => document.querySelector<HTMLFormElement>("#list-form")!.hidden = false);
+document.querySelector<HTMLFormElement>("#list-form")!.addEventListener("submit", async event => {
+  event.preventDefault();
+  if (!contract) return void (status.textContent = "Connect your wallet first.");
+  const data = new FormData(event.currentTarget);
+  try {
+    const tx = await contract.listTool(data.get("name"), data.get("photo"), data.get("condition"), parseUnits(String(data.get("deposit")), 6), parseUnits(String(data.get("fee")), 6));
+    status.textContent = "Publishing tool…"; await tx.wait(); event.currentTarget.reset(); event.currentTarget.hidden = true; await loadTools();
+  } catch (error) { status.textContent = error instanceof Error ? error.message : "Listing failed"; }
+});
+
