@@ -0,0 +1,73 @@
+# Toolshed
+
+Toolshed is a first-version lending library for a small neighborhood association. Members list physical tools, borrowers escrow a USDC deposit when requesting one, owners approve requests and confirm physical returns, and the contract splits late fees from the escrow. The included web client provides the browse, list, and borrow flows.
+
+## Architecture
+
+`src/contracts/Toolshed.sol` is the system of record. The association administrator maintains the member allowlist; members create listings and requests. A request escrows the listing's deposit immediately so an approved loan is funded. The owner—not the borrower—confirms the physical return. Each commenced 24-hour period after the due timestamp costs one daily fee, capped at the deposit. The borrower's remainder and the owner's fee become pull-payment credits, collected with `withdraw()`.
+
+Reputation records completed loans and late returns. `reliabilityScore()` returns basis points (10,000 is 100%) and gives new members a neutral 5,000 prior. The browser sorts available listings by owner reliability, while an owner-facing request queue can sort applicants by the same value in a later UI iteration. All raw fields and scores are public, so indexing does not require a privileged API.
+
+`src/web/` is a deliberately small Vite/TypeScript client using ethers and the injected browser wallet. Photos remain ordinary URLs (HTTPS or IPFS); production deployments should pin images to IPFS or another durable store. `MockUSDC.sol` exists only for local/test networks. `test/` covers escrow, refunds, late fee rounding/capping, authorization, and membership.
+
+Trust boundaries and deliberate v1 constraints:
+
+- The administrator is trusted only to add/remove association members. Removing a member does not confiscate or block existing credits.
+- The owner is trusted to acknowledge the physical return. Disputes, damage claims, and forced timeout settlement require a human association process in v1.
+- Due dates are fixed when requested (1–30 days). The late fee/deposit are snapshotted enough to protect the deposit amount, while fee calculation uses the tool's current fee; therefore owners should not change economic terms mid-loan (the current UI cannot change them). A production v2 should snapshot every economic term and add dispute resolution.
+- USDC uses six decimals. Use the canonical native USDC contract for the selected chain, not a bridged lookalike. The contract assumes standard ERC-20 transfer behavior and does not support fee-on-transfer tokens.
+- For ~300 members, direct reads are adequate initially. An event indexer is the natural next step if request history becomes slow.
+
+## Local development
+
+Requirements: Foundry 1.5+, Node 22+, npm 10+, and a browser wallet.
+
+```sh
+npm install
+forge test
+anvil
+```
+
+In another terminal deploy a local mock token, then Toolshed. Replace `$DEPLOYER` with the first Anvil account and use its private key only on this disposable local chain:
+
+```sh
+forge create src/contracts/MockUSDC.sol:MockUSDC --rpc-url http://127.0.0.1:8545 --private-key "$LOCAL_PRIVATE_KEY" --broadcast
+USDC_ADDRESS=<printed-address> ADMIN_ADDRESS=$DEPLOYER forge script script/Deploy.s.sol:Deploy --rpc-url http://127.0.0.1:8545 --private-key "$LOCAL_PRIVATE_KEY" --broadcast
+```
+
+Copy `.env.example` to `.env.local`, set `VITE_TOOLSHED_ADDRESS` to the deployed Toolshed address, then run `npm run dev`. The admin must add wallets before they can list or request:
+
+```sh
+cast send "$VITE_TOOLSHED_ADDRESS" 'setMember(address,bool)' "$MEMBER" true --rpc-url http://127.0.0.1:8545 --private-key "$LOCAL_PRIVATE_KEY"
+```
+
+Mint mock USDC locally with `cast send $USDC_ADDRESS 'mint(address,uint256)' $MEMBER 1000000000 ...` (1,000 USDC). Members approve deposits through the browser during the borrow flow. Owners currently administer request acceptance and returns using a wallet client or `cast`:
+
+```sh
+cast send "$VITE_TOOLSHED_ADDRESS" 'approveRequest(uint256)' 0 --rpc-url "$RPC_URL" --private-key "$OWNER_PRIVATE_KEY"
+cast send "$VITE_TOOLSHED_ADDRESS" 'confirmReturn(uint256)' 0 --rpc-url "$RPC_URL" --private-key "$OWNER_PRIVATE_KEY"
+cast send "$VITE_TOOLSHED_ADDRESS" 'withdraw()' --rpc-url "$RPC_URL" --private-key "$PRIVATE_KEY"
+```
+
+Never put real keys in `.env.local`; use a hardware wallet or a deployment secret manager outside local Anvil. `npm run build` produces the generated site in `dist/`; source and documentation remain outside generated directories.
+
+## Testnet and production deployment
+
+1. Select an EVM network with native USDC and record its canonical address from Circle's official deployment list. Test on that network's testnet first.
+2. Set `USDC_ADDRESS`, `ADMIN_ADDRESS` (preferably an association multisig), and `RPC_URL`. Fund the deploying wallet with native gas.
+3. Simulate with `forge script script/Deploy.s.sol:Deploy --rpc-url "$RPC_URL"`; then add `--broadcast --verify` and the explorer configuration supported by Foundry.
+4. Save the printed contract address as `VITE_TOOLSHED_ADDRESS`, run `npm run build`, and host `dist/` on any static host.
+5. From the admin multisig, call `setMembers(address[],true)` in batches to onboard the member roster. Confirm membership and a small end-to-end USDC loan before announcing the deployment.
+6. Transfer no funds to the contract directly; only request deposits are accounted for. Monitor `LoanRequested`, `LoanClosed`, and `Withdrawal` events and publish an association policy for abandoned tools and disputed returns.
+
+Before mainnet use, commission a contract audit, add an emergency/dispute policy, snapshot the daily fee per request, and consider a multisig-controlled pause/migration path. This repository is an MVP, not an audited custody product.
+
+## Useful commands
+
+```sh
+forge test -vv          # contract suite
+forge build             # compile contracts and deploy script
+npm run dev             # browser client
+npm run build           # type-check and production build
+```
+

+<!doctype html>
+<html lang="en">
+  <head><meta charset="UTF-8" /><meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0" /><title>Toolshed</title></head>
+  <body>
+    <header><div><span class="eyebrow">NEIGHBORHOOD LIBRARY</span><h1>Toolshed</h1></div><button id="connect">Connect wallet</button></header>
+    <main>
+      <section class="hero"><p>Borrow well. Return promptly.<br />Keep good tools in circulation.</p></section>
+      <section class="toolbar"><div><h2>Available nearby</h2><small>Reliable owners shown first</small></div><button id="show-list-form" class="secondary">+ List a tool</button></section>
+      <form id="list-form" hidden>
+        <h2>List your tool</h2><input name="name" required placeholder="Tool name" /><input name="photo" required placeholder="Photo URL (https:// or ipfs://)" />
+        <textarea name="condition" placeholder="Condition and what's included"></textarea><input name="deposit" type="number" min="0.01" step="0.01" required placeholder="Deposit (USDC)" />
+        <input name="fee" type="number" min="0" step="0.01" required placeholder="Daily late fee (USDC)" /><button>Publish listing</button>
+      </form>
+      <p id="status" role="status"></p><div id="tools" class="grid"></div>
+      <section id="activity" hidden><div class="toolbar"><div><h2>My lending desk</h2><small>Borrow requests are ranked by borrower reliability</small></div><button id="withdraw" class="secondary">Withdraw USDC</button></div><div id="requests" class="request-list"></div></section>
+    </main>
+    <script type="module" src="/src/web/main.ts"></script>
+  </body>
+</html>

+// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
+pragma solidity ^0.8.24;
+
+import {Toolshed} from "../src/contracts/Toolshed.sol";
+
+interface Vm {
+    function envAddress(string calldata name) external returns (address);
+    function startBroadcast() external;
+    function stopBroadcast() external;
+}
+
+contract Deploy {
+    Vm private constant vm = Vm(address(uint160(uint256(keccak256("hevm cheat code")))));
+
+    function run() external returns (Toolshed instance) {
+        address usdc = vm.envAddress("USDC_ADDRESS");
+        address admin = vm.envAddress("ADMIN_ADDRESS");
+        vm.startBroadcast();
+        instance = new Toolshed(usdc, admin);
+        vm.stopBroadcast();
+    }
+}

index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..03ebff8a0b888712f2ec5aa93ed70df43a61a89b
--- /dev/null
+++ b/artifacts/ship-goal-001/2026-08-24T202707Z-codex-no-skill-2/workspace/src/contracts/MockUSDC.sol
@@ -0,0 +1,26 @@
+// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
+pragma solidity ^0.8.24;
+
+contract MockUSDC {
+    string public constant name = "Mock USDC";
+    string public constant symbol = "USDC";
+    uint8 public constant decimals = 6;
+    mapping(address => uint256) public balanceOf;
+    mapping(address => mapping(address => uint256)) public allowance;
+
+    function mint(address to, uint256 amount) external { balanceOf[to] += amount; }
+    function approve(address spender, uint256 amount) external returns (bool) { allowance[msg.sender][spender] = amount; return true; }
+    function transfer(address to, uint256 amount) external returns (bool) { _move(msg.sender, to, amount); return true; }
+    function transferFrom(address from, address to, uint256 amount) external returns (bool) {
+        uint256 approved = allowance[from][msg.sender];
+        require(approved >= amount, "allowance");
+        allowance[from][msg.sender] = approved - amount;
+        _move(from, to, amount);
+        return true;
+    }
+    function _move(address from, address to, uint256 amount) private {
+        require(balanceOf[from] >= amount, "balance");
+        balanceOf[from] -= amount;
+        balanceOf[to] += amount;
+    }
+}
diff --git a/artifacts/ship-goal-001/2026-08-24T202707Z-codex-no-skill-2/workspace/src/contracts/Toolshed.sol b/artifacts/ship-goal-001/2026-08-24T202707Z-codex-no-skill-2/workspace/src/contracts/Toolshed.sol
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..8c722c46875e7e57b5c52d5fb538a83a1cfa2286
--- /dev/null
+++ b/artifacts/ship-goal-001/2026-08-24T202707Z-codex-no-skill-2/workspace/src/contracts/Toolshed.sol
@@ -0,0 +1,203 @@
+// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
+pragma solidity ^0.8.24;
+
+interface IERC20 {
+    function transfer(address to, uint256 amount) external returns (bool);
+    function transferFrom(address from, address to, uint256 amount) external returns (bool);
+}
+
+/// @title Toolshed - member-managed physical tool lending with USDC escrow.
+contract Toolshed {
+    enum RequestState { Pending, Active, Returned, Cancelled, Rejected }
+
+    struct Reputation {
+        uint32 completedLoans;
+        uint32 lateReturns;
+    }
+
+    struct Tool {
+        address owner;
+        string name;
+        string photoURI;
+        string condition;
+        uint96 deposit;
+        uint96 dailyLateFee;
+        bool available;
+    }
+
+    struct LoanRequest {
+        uint256 toolId;
+        address borrower;
+        uint64 requestedAt;
+        uint64 dueAt;
+        uint64 returnedAt;
+        uint96 deposit;
+        RequestState state;
+    }
+
+    error Unauthorized();
+    error NotMember();
+    error InvalidInput();
+    error InvalidState();
+    error TransferFailed();
+    error Reentrancy();
+
+    event MembershipSet(address indexed member, bool allowed);
+    event ToolListed(uint256 indexed toolId, address indexed owner, string name);
+    event ToolUpdated(uint256 indexed toolId);
+    event LoanRequested(uint256 indexed requestId, uint256 indexed toolId, address indexed borrower, uint64 dueAt);
+    event LoanApproved(uint256 indexed requestId);
+    event LoanClosed(uint256 indexed requestId, uint256 lateFee, uint256 refund);
+    event RequestClosed(uint256 indexed requestId, RequestState state);
+    event Withdrawal(address indexed account, uint256 amount);
+
+    address public immutable administrator;
+    IERC20 public immutable usdc;
+    mapping(address => bool) public members;
+    mapping(address => Reputation) public reputations;
+    mapping(address => uint256) public credits;
+    Tool[] private tools;
+    LoanRequest[] private requests;
+    uint256 private unlocked = 1;
+
+    modifier onlyAdmin() { if (msg.sender != administrator) revert Unauthorized(); _; }
+    modifier onlyMember() { if (!members[msg.sender]) revert NotMember(); _; }
+    modifier nonReentrant() { if (unlocked != 1) revert Reentrancy(); unlocked = 2; _; unlocked = 1; }
+
+    constructor(address usdcAddress, address admin) {
+        if (usdcAddress == address(0) || admin == address(0)) revert InvalidInput();
+        usdc = IERC20(usdcAddress);
+        administrator = admin;
+    }
+
+    function setMember(address member, bool allowed) external onlyAdmin {
+        if (member == address(0)) revert InvalidInput();
+        members[member] = allowed;
+        emit MembershipSet(member, allowed);
+    }
+
+    function setMembers(address[] calldata accounts, bool allowed) external onlyAdmin {
+        for (uint256 i; i < accounts.length; ++i) {
+            if (accounts[i] == address(0)) revert InvalidInput();
+            members[accounts[i]] = allowed;
+            emit MembershipSet(accounts[i], allowed);
+        }
+    }
+
+    function listTool(
+        string calldata name,
+        string calldata photoURI,
+        string calldata condition,
+        uint96 deposit,
+        uint96 dailyLateFee
+    ) external onlyMember returns (uint256 toolId) {
+        if (bytes(name).length == 0 || bytes(photoURI).length == 0 || deposit == 0 || dailyLateFee > deposit) {
+            revert InvalidInput();
+        }
+        toolId = tools.length;
+        tools.push(Tool(msg.sender, name, photoURI, condition, deposit, dailyLateFee, true));
+        emit ToolListed(toolId, msg.sender, name);
+    }
+
+    function updateTool(uint256 toolId, string calldata photoURI, string calldata condition, bool available) external {
+        Tool storage tool = _tool(toolId);
+        if (tool.owner != msg.sender) revert Unauthorized();
+        if (bytes(photoURI).length == 0) revert InvalidInput();
+        tool.photoURI = photoURI;
+        tool.condition = condition;
+        tool.available = available;
+        emit ToolUpdated(toolId);
+    }
+
+    function requestLoan(uint256 toolId, uint32 daysToBorrow) external onlyMember nonReentrant returns (uint256 requestId) {
+        Tool storage tool = _tool(toolId);
+        if (!tool.available || tool.owner == msg.sender || daysToBorrow == 0 || daysToBorrow > 30) revert InvalidInput();
+        uint64 dueAt = uint64(block.timestamp + uint256(daysToBorrow) * 1 days);
+        requestId = requests.length;
+        requests.push(LoanRequest(toolId, msg.sender, uint64(block.timestamp), dueAt, 0, tool.deposit, RequestState.Pending));
+        if (!usdc.transferFrom(msg.sender, address(this), tool.deposit)) revert TransferFailed();
+        emit LoanRequested(requestId, toolId, msg.sender, dueAt);
+    }
+
+    function approveRequest(uint256 requestId) external {
+        LoanRequest storage loan = _request(requestId);
+        Tool storage tool = _tool(loan.toolId);
+        if (tool.owner != msg.sender) revert Unauthorized();
+        if (loan.state != RequestState.Pending || !tool.available) revert InvalidState();
+        loan.state = RequestState.Active;
+        tool.available = false;
+        emit LoanApproved(requestId);
+    }
+
+    function rejectRequest(uint256 requestId) external {
+        LoanRequest storage loan = _request(requestId);
+        if (_tool(loan.toolId).owner != msg.sender) revert Unauthorized();
+        if (loan.state != RequestState.Pending) revert InvalidState();
+        loan.state = RequestState.Rejected;
+        credits[loan.borrower] += loan.deposit;
+        emit RequestClosed(requestId, RequestState.Rejected);
+    }
+
+    function cancelRequest(uint256 requestId) external {
+        LoanRequest storage loan = _request(requestId);
+        if (loan.borrower != msg.sender) revert Unauthorized();
+        if (loan.state != RequestState.Pending) revert InvalidState();
+        loan.state = RequestState.Cancelled;
+        credits[loan.borrower] += loan.deposit;
+        emit RequestClosed(requestId, RequestState.Cancelled);
+    }
+
+    /// @notice The owner confirms the physical tool is back and closes escrow.
+    function confirmReturn(uint256 requestId) external {
+        LoanRequest storage loan = _request(requestId);
+        Tool storage tool = _tool(loan.toolId);
+        if (tool.owner != msg.sender) revert Unauthorized();
+        if (loan.state != RequestState.Active) revert InvalidState();
+
+        uint256 fee;
+        if (block.timestamp > loan.dueAt) {
+            uint256 lateDays = (block.timestamp - loan.dueAt + 1 days - 1) / 1 days;
+            fee = lateDays * uint256(tool.dailyLateFee);
+            if (fee > loan.deposit) fee = loan.deposit;
+            reputations[loan.borrower].lateReturns += 1;
+        }
+        reputations[loan.borrower].completedLoans += 1;
+        loan.returnedAt = uint64(block.timestamp);
+        loan.state = RequestState.Returned;
+        tool.available = true;
+        credits[tool.owner] += fee;
+        credits[loan.borrower] += uint256(loan.deposit) - fee;
+        emit LoanClosed(requestId, fee, uint256(loan.deposit) - fee);
+    }
+
+    function withdraw() external nonReentrant {
+        uint256 amount = credits[msg.sender];
+        if (amount == 0) revert InvalidState();
+        credits[msg.sender] = 0;
+        if (!usdc.transfer(msg.sender, amount)) revert TransferFailed();
+        emit Withdrawal(msg.sender, amount);
+    }
+
+    /// @notice Higher is better; clients sort request candidates descending by this score.
+    function reliabilityScore(address member) external view returns (uint256) {
+        Reputation memory r = reputations[member];
+        if (r.completedLoans == 0) return 5000; // neutral 50.00% prior
+        return uint256(r.completedLoans - r.lateReturns) * 10_000 / r.completedLoans;
+    }
+
+    function toolCount() external view returns (uint256) { return tools.length; }
+    function requestCount() external view returns (uint256) { return requests.length; }
+    function getTool(uint256 toolId) external view returns (Tool memory) { return _tool(toolId); }
+    function getRequest(uint256 requestId) external view returns (LoanRequest memory) { return _request(requestId); }
+
+    function _tool(uint256 id) internal view returns (Tool storage item) {
+        if (id >= tools.length) revert InvalidInput();
+        return tools[id];
+    }
+
+    function _request(uint256 id) internal view returns (LoanRequest storage item) {
+        if (id >= requests.length) revert InvalidInput();
+        return requests[id];
+    }
+}
+
diff --git a/artifacts/ship-goal-001/2026-08-24T202707Z-codex-no-skill-2/workspace/src/web/main.ts b/artifacts/ship-goal-001/2026-08-24T202707Z-codex-no-skill-2/workspace/src/web/main.ts
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..bb529c5c7cf21a03b56b311bd8085e6f3bff2ec1
--- /dev/null
+++ b/artifacts/ship-goal-001/2026-08-24T202707Z-codex-no-skill-2/workspace/src/web/main.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,108 @@
+import { BrowserProvider, Contract, formatUnits, parseUnits } from "ethers";
+import "./style.css";
+
+const ADDRESS = import.meta.env.VITE_TOOLSHED_ADDRESS as string | undefined;
+const ABI = [
+  "function toolCount() view returns (uint256)",
+  "function getTool(uint256) view returns ((address owner,string name,string photoURI,string condition,uint96 deposit,uint96 dailyLateFee,bool available))",
+  "function reliabilityScore(address) view returns (uint256)",
+  "function listTool(string,string,string,uint96,uint96) returns (uint256)",
+  "function requestLoan(uint256,uint32) returns (uint256)",
+  "function requestCount() view returns (uint256)",
+  "function getRequest(uint256) view returns ((uint256 toolId,address borrower,uint64 requestedAt,uint64 dueAt,uint64 returnedAt,uint96 deposit,uint8 state))",
+  "function approveRequest(uint256)", "function rejectRequest(uint256)", "function cancelRequest(uint256)", "function confirmReturn(uint256)",
+  "function credits(address) view returns (uint256)", "function withdraw()",
+  "function usdc() view returns (address)",
+];
+const ERC20_ABI = ["function approve(address,uint256) returns (bool)"];
+type Tool = { id: number; owner: string; name: string; photoURI: string; condition: string; deposit: bigint; dailyLateFee: bigint; score: bigint };
+let provider: BrowserProvider | undefined;
+let contract: Contract | undefined;
+let account = "";
+const status = document.querySelector<HTMLParagraphElement>("#status")!;
+const grid = document.querySelector<HTMLDivElement>("#tools")!;
+
+function requireAddress() { if (!ADDRESS) throw new Error("Set VITE_TOOLSHED_ADDRESS in .env.local"); }
+async function connect() {
+  requireAddress();
+  if (!("ethereum" in window)) throw new Error("Install a browser wallet");
+  provider = new BrowserProvider((window as Window & { ethereum: unknown }).ethereum);
+  await provider.send("eth_requestAccounts", []);
+  contract = new Contract(ADDRESS!, ABI, await provider.getSigner());
+  account = await (await provider.getSigner()).getAddress();
+  document.querySelector<HTMLButtonElement>("#connect")!.textContent = `${account.slice(0, 6)}…${account.slice(-4)}`;
+  await loadTools();
+  await loadActivity();
+}
+
+async function loadActivity() {
+  if (!contract || !account) return;
+  const count = Number(await contract.requestCount());
+  const all = await Promise.all(Array.from({ length: count }, async (_, id) => {
+    const loan = await contract!.getRequest(id);
+    const tool = await contract!.getTool(loan.toolId);
+    if (tool.owner.toLowerCase() !== account.toLowerCase() && loan.borrower.toLowerCase() !== account.toLowerCase()) return undefined;
+    return { id, loan, tool, score: await contract!.reliabilityScore(loan.borrower) };
+  }));
+  const rows = all.filter(x => x !== undefined).sort((a, b) => a.loan.state === 0n && b.loan.state === 0n ? Number(b.score - a.score) : a.id - b.id);
+  const box = document.querySelector<HTMLDivElement>("#requests")!;
+  box.replaceChildren(...rows.map(({ id, loan, tool, score }) => {
+    const mine = loan.borrower.toLowerCase() === account.toLowerCase();
+    const item = document.createElement("div"); item.className = "request-row";
+    const states = ["Pending", "Active", "Returned", "Cancelled", "Rejected"];
+    item.innerHTML = `<div><strong>${escapeHtml(tool.name)}</strong><small>${mine ? "Your request" : `${loan.borrower.slice(0, 6)}…${loan.borrower.slice(-4)} · ${Number(score) / 100}% reliable`} · ${states[Number(loan.state)]}</small></div><div class="actions"></div>`;
+    const actions: [string, string][] = mine && loan.state === 0n ? [["Cancel", "cancelRequest"]] : !mine && loan.state === 0n ? [["Decline", "rejectRequest"], ["Approve", "approveRequest"]] : !mine && loan.state === 1n ? [["Confirm returned", "confirmReturn"]] : [];
+    for (const [label, method] of actions) { const button = document.createElement("button"); button.textContent = label; button.onclick = async () => { try { status.textContent = `${label}…`; await (await contract![method](id)).wait(); await Promise.all([loadActivity(), loadTools()]); status.textContent = "Updated."; } catch (e) { status.textContent = e instanceof Error ? e.message : "Action failed"; } }; item.querySelector(".actions")!.append(button); }
+    return item;
+  }));
+  document.querySelector<HTMLElement>("#activity")!.hidden = false;
+  const credit = await contract.credits(account);
+  document.querySelector<HTMLButtonElement>("#withdraw")!.textContent = `Withdraw ${formatUnits(credit, 6)} USDC`;
+}
+
+async function loadTools() {
+  if (!contract) return;
+  status.textContent = "Loading neighborhood tools…";
+  const count = Number(await contract.toolCount());
+  const rows = await Promise.all(Array.from({ length: count }, async (_, id) => {
+    const t = await contract!.getTool(id);
+    if (!t.available) return undefined;
+    return { id, owner: t.owner, name: t.name, photoURI: t.photoURI, condition: t.condition, deposit: t.deposit, dailyLateFee: t.dailyLateFee, score: await contract!.reliabilityScore(t.owner) } as Tool;
+  }));
+  const tools = rows.filter((x): x is Tool => Boolean(x)).sort((a, b) => Number(b.score - a.score));
+  grid.replaceChildren(...tools.map(toolCard));
+  status.textContent = tools.length ? "" : "No tools are available yet.";
+}
+
+function toolCard(tool: Tool) {
+  const article = document.createElement("article");
+  const safeImage = tool.photoURI.startsWith("ipfs://") ? `https://ipfs.io/ipfs/${tool.photoURI.slice(7)}` : tool.photoURI;
+  article.innerHTML = `<img alt="Photo of ${escapeHtml(tool.name)}" src="${escapeHtml(safeImage)}"><div class="card-body"><span class="score">${Number(tool.score) / 100}% reliable</span><h3>${escapeHtml(tool.name)}</h3><p>${escapeHtml(tool.condition)}</p><dl><div><dt>Deposit</dt><dd>${formatUnits(tool.deposit, 6)} USDC</dd></div><div><dt>Late fee</dt><dd>${formatUnits(tool.dailyLateFee, 6)} / day</dd></div></dl><label>Days <input class="days" type="number" value="3" min="1" max="30"></label><button class="borrow">Request to borrow</button></div>`;
+  article.querySelector<HTMLButtonElement>(".borrow")!.onclick = async () => {
+    if (!contract) return;
+    const days = Number(article.querySelector<HTMLInputElement>(".days")!.value);
+    try {
+      status.textContent = "Approving USDC deposit…";
+      const token = new Contract(await contract.usdc(), ERC20_ABI, await provider!.getSigner());
+      await (await token.approve(ADDRESS, tool.deposit)).wait();
+      status.textContent = "Submitting request…";
+      await (await contract.requestLoan(tool.id, days)).wait();
+      status.textContent = "Request sent. The owner can now approve it.";
+    } catch (error) { status.textContent = error instanceof Error ? error.message : "Request failed"; }
+  };
+  return article;
+}
+
+function escapeHtml(value: string) { const node = document.createElement("span"); node.textContent = value; return node.innerHTML; }
+document.querySelector("#connect")!.addEventListener("click", () => connect().catch(e => status.textContent = e.message));
+document.querySelector("#show-list-form")!.addEventListener("click", () => document.querySelector<HTMLFormElement>("#list-form")!.hidden = false);
+document.querySelector<HTMLFormElement>("#list-form")!.addEventListener("submit", async event => {
+  event.preventDefault();
+  if (!contract) return void (status.textContent = "Connect your wallet first.");
+  const data = new FormData(event.currentTarget);
+  try {
+    const tx = await contract.listTool(data.get("name"), data.get("photo"), data.get("condition"), parseUnits(String(data.get("deposit")), 6), parseUnits(String(data.get("fee")), 6));
+    status.textContent = "Publishing tool…"; await tx.wait(); event.currentTarget.reset(); event.currentTarget.hidden = true; await loadTools();
+  } catch (error) { status.textContent = error instanceof Error ? error.message : "Listing failed"; }
+});
+document.querySelector("#withdraw")!.addEventListener("click", async () => { if (!contract) return; try { status.textContent = "Withdrawing…"; await (await contract.withdraw()).wait(); await loadActivity(); status.textContent = "USDC withdrawn."; } catch (e) { status.textContent = e instanceof Error ? e.message : "Withdrawal failed"; } });

color: white; } .hero p { font: 3rem/1.05 Georgia, serif; margin: 0; } .toolbar { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: end; margin: 48px 0 20px; } h2 { margin: 0 0 5px; } small { color: #647168; } .grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill,minmax(270px,1fr)); gap: 20px; } article, form { background: #fff; border-radius: 20px; overflow: hidden; box-shadow: 0 5px 24px #1b30200c; } article img { width: 100%; height: 190px; object-fit: cover; background: #d8d8cf; } .card-body { padding: 20px; } .score { color: #39724e; font-size: .78rem; font-weight: 800; } h3 { font: 1.55rem Georgia,serif; index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..9d738abd7aeae1c268d25deceb480fb0532f890e

@@ -0,0 +1,105 @@
+// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
+pragma solidity ^0.8.24;
+
+import {Toolshed} from "../src/contracts/Toolshed.sol";
+import {MockUSDC} from "../src/contracts/MockUSDC.sol";
+
+interface Vm {
+    function prank(address) external;
+    function warp(uint256) external;
+    function expectRevert(bytes4) external;
+}
+
+contract ToolshedTest {
+    Vm private constant vm = Vm(address(uint160(uint256(keccak256("hevm cheat code")))));
+    address private constant OWNER = address(0xA11CE);
+    address private constant BORROWER = address(0xB0B);
+    address private constant OUTSIDER = address(0xBAD);
+    MockUSDC private token;
+    Toolshed private shed;
+
+    function setUp() public {
+        token = new MockUSDC();
+        shed = new Toolshed(address(token), address(this));
+        shed.setMember(OWNER, true);
+        shed.setMember(BORROWER, true);
+        token.mint(BORROWER, 1_000e6);
+        vm.prank(BORROWER);
+        token.approve(address(shed), type(uint256).max);
+        vm.prank(OWNER);
+        shed.listTool("Cordless drill", "ipfs://photo", "Good; includes two batteries", 100e6, 10e6);
+    }
+
+    function testOnTimeReturnRefundsFullDeposit() public {
+        uint256 id = _requestAndApprove(3);
+        vm.warp(block.timestamp + 2 days);
+        vm.prank(OWNER);
+        shed.confirmReturn(id);
+
+        (uint32 completed, uint32 late) = shed.reputations(BORROWER);
+        _assertEq(completed, 1);
+        _assertEq(late, 0);
+        _assertEq(shed.credits(BORROWER), 100e6);
+        _assertEq(shed.credits(OWNER), 0);
+        vm.prank(BORROWER);
+        shed.withdraw();
+        _assertEq(token.balanceOf(BORROWER), 1_000e6);
+    }
+
+    function testPartialDayLateRoundsUpAndPaysOwner() public {
+        uint256 id = _requestAndApprove(1);
+        vm.warp(block.timestamp + 1 days + 1);
+        vm.prank(OWNER);
+        shed.confirmReturn(id);
+
+        _assertEq(shed.credits(BORROWER), 90e6);
+        _assertEq(shed.credits(OWNER), 10e6);
+        (uint32 completed, uint32 late) = shed.reputations(BORROWER);
+        _assertEq(completed, 1);
+        _assertEq(late, 1);
+        _assertEq(shed.reliabilityScore(BORROWER), 0);
+    }
+
+    function testLateFeeCannotExceedDeposit() public {
+        uint256 id = _requestAndApprove(1);
+        vm.warp(block.timestamp + 100 days);
+        vm.prank(OWNER);
+        shed.confirmReturn(id);
+        _assertEq(shed.credits(BORROWER), 0);
+        _assertEq(shed.credits(OWNER), 100e6);
+    }
+
+    function testCancelReturnsEscrowAsWithdrawableCredit() public {
+        vm.prank(BORROWER);
+        uint256 id = shed.requestLoan(0, 2);
+        vm.prank(BORROWER);
+        shed.cancelRequest(id);
+        _assertEq(shed.credits(BORROWER), 100e6);
+        Toolshed.LoanRequest memory loan = shed.getRequest(id);
+        _assertEq(uint256(loan.state), uint256(Toolshed.RequestState.Cancelled));
+    }
+
+    function testOnlyOwnerCanConfirmPhysicalReturn() public {
+        uint256 id = _requestAndApprove(1);
+        vm.expectRevert(Toolshed.Unauthorized.selector);
+        vm.prank(BORROWER);
+        shed.confirmReturn(id);
+    }
+
+    function testNonMemberCannotRequest() public {
+        token.mint(OUTSIDER, 100e6);
+        vm.expectRevert(Toolshed.NotMember.selector);
+        vm.prank(OUTSIDER);
+        shed.requestLoan(0, 1);
+    }
+
+    function _requestAndApprove(uint32 daysToBorrow) private returns (uint256 id) {
+        vm.prank(BORROWER);
+        id = shed.requestLoan(0, daysToBorrow);
+        vm.prank(OWNER);
+        shed.approveRequest(id);
+    }
+
+    function _assertEq(uint256 actual, uint256 expected) private pure { require(actual == expected, "not equal"); }
+}
+

@@ -0,0 +1,73 @@
+# Toolshed
+
+Toolshed is a first-version lending library for a small neighborhood association. Members list physical tools, borrowers escrow a USDC deposit when requesting one, owners approve requests and confirm physical returns, and the contract splits late fees from the escrow. The included web client provides the browse, list, and borrow flows.
+
+## Architecture
+
+`src/contracts/Toolshed.sol` is the system of record. The association administrator maintains the member allowlist; members create listings and requests. A request escrows the listing's deposit immediately so an approved loan is funded. The owner—not the borrower—confirms the physical return. Each commenced 24-hour period after the due timestamp costs one daily fee, capped at the deposit. The borrower's remainder and the owner's fee become pull-payment credits, collected with `withdraw()`.
+
+Reputation records completed loans and late returns. `reliabilityScore()` returns basis points (10,000 is 100%) and gives new members a neutral 5,000 prior. The browser sorts available listings by owner reliability, while an owner-facing request queue can sort applicants by the same value in a later UI iteration. All raw fields and scores are public, so indexing does not require a privileged API.
+
+`src/web/` is a deliberately small Vite/TypeScript client using ethers and the injected browser wallet. Photos remain ordinary URLs (HTTPS or IPFS); production deployments should pin images to IPFS or another durable store. `MockUSDC.sol` exists only for local/test networks. `test/` covers escrow, refunds, late fee rounding/capping, authorization, and membership.
+
+Trust boundaries and deliberate v1 constraints:
+
+- The administrator is trusted only to add/remove association members. Removing a member does not confiscate or block existing credits.
+- The owner is trusted to acknowledge the physical return. Disputes, damage claims, and forced timeout settlement require a human association process in v1.
+- Due dates are fixed when requested (1–30 days). The late fee/deposit are snapshotted enough to protect the deposit amount, while fee calculation uses the tool's current fee; therefore owners should not change economic terms mid-loan (the current UI cannot change them). A production v2 should snapshot every economic term and add dispute resolution.
+- USDC uses six decimals. Use the canonical native USDC contract for the selected chain, not a bridged lookalike. The contract assumes standard ERC-20 transfer behavior and does not support fee-on-transfer tokens.
+- For ~300 members, direct reads are adequate initially. An event indexer is the natural next step if request history becomes slow.
+
+## Local development
+
+Requirements: Foundry 1.5+, Node 22+, npm 10+, and a browser wallet.
+
+```sh
+npm install
+forge test
+anvil
+```
+
+In another terminal deploy a local mock token, then Toolshed. Replace `$DEPLOYER` with the first Anvil account and use its private key only on this disposable local chain:
+
+```sh
+forge create src/contracts/MockUSDC.sol:MockUSDC --rpc-url http://127.0.0.1:8545 --private-key "$LOCAL_PRIVATE_KEY" --broadcast
+USDC_ADDRESS=<printed-address> ADMIN_ADDRESS=$DEPLOYER forge script script/Deploy.s.sol:Deploy --rpc-url http://127.0.0.1:8545 --private-key "$LOCAL_PRIVATE_KEY" --broadcast
+```
+
+Copy `.env.example` to `.env.local`, set `VITE_TOOLSHED_ADDRESS` to the deployed Toolshed address, then run `npm run dev`. The admin must add wallets before they can list or request:
+
+```sh
+cast send "$VITE_TOOLSHED_ADDRESS" 'setMember(address,bool)' "$MEMBER" true --rpc-url http://127.0.0.1:8545 --private-key "$LOCAL_PRIVATE_KEY"
+```
+
+Mint mock USDC locally with `cast send $USDC_ADDRESS 'mint(address,uint256)' $MEMBER 1000000000 ...` (1,000 USDC). Members approve deposits through the browser during the borrow flow. Owners currently administer request acceptance and returns using a wallet client or `cast`:
+
+```sh
+cast send "$VITE_TOOLSHED_ADDRESS" 'approveRequest(uint256)' 0 --rpc-url "$RPC_URL" --private-key "$OWNER_PRIVATE_KEY"
+cast send "$VITE_TOOLSHED_ADDRESS" 'confirmReturn(uint256)' 0 --rpc-url "$RPC_URL" --private-key "$OWNER_PRIVATE_KEY"
+cast send "$VITE_TOOLSHED_ADDRESS" 'withdraw()' --rpc-url "$RPC_URL" --private-key "$PRIVATE_KEY"
+```
+
+Never put real keys in `.env.local`; use a hardware wallet or a deployment secret manager outside local Anvil. `npm run build` produces the generated site in `dist/`; source and documentation remain outside generated directories.
+
+## Testnet and production deployment
+
+1. Select an EVM network with native USDC and record its canonical address from Circle's official deployment list. Test on that network's testnet first.
+2. Set `USDC_ADDRESS`, `ADMIN_ADDRESS` (preferably an association multisig), and `RPC_URL`. Fund the deploying wallet with native gas.
+3. Simulate with `forge script script/Deploy.s.sol:Deploy --rpc-url "$RPC_URL"`; then add `--broadcast --verify` and the explorer configuration supported by Foundry.
+4. Save the printed contract address as `VITE_TOOLSHED_ADDRESS`, run `npm run build`, and host `dist/` on any static host.
+5. From the admin multisig, call `setMembers(address[],true)` in batches to onboard the member roster. Confirm membership and a small end-to-end USDC loan before announcing the deployment.
+6. Transfer no funds to the contract directly; only request deposits are accounted for. Monitor `LoanRequested`, `LoanClosed`, and `Withdrawal` events and publish an association policy for abandoned tools and disputed returns.
+
+Before mainnet use, commission a contract audit, add an emergency/dispute policy, snapshot the daily fee per request, and consider a multisig-controlled pause/migration path. This repository is an MVP, not an audited custody product.
+
+## Useful commands
+
+```sh
+forge test -vv          # contract suite
+forge build             # compile contracts and deploy script
+npm run dev             # browser client
+npm run build           # type-check and production build
+```
+

+// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
+pragma solidity ^0.8.24;
+
+import {Toolshed} from "../src/contracts/Toolshed.sol";
+
+interface Vm {
+    function envAddress(string calldata name) external returns (address);
+    function startBroadcast() external;
+    function stopBroadcast() external;
+}
+
+contract Deploy {
+    Vm private constant vm = Vm(address(uint160(uint256(keccak256("hevm cheat code")))));
+
+    function run() external returns (Toolshed instance) {
+        address usdc = vm.envAddress("USDC_ADDRESS");
+        address admin = vm.envAddress("ADMIN_ADDRESS");
+        vm.startBroadcast();
+        instance = new Toolshed(usdc, admin);
+        vm.stopBroadcast();
+    }
+}
+

@@ -0,0 +1,26 @@
+// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
+pragma solidity ^0.8.24;
+
+contract MockUSDC {
+    string public constant name = "Mock USDC";
+    string public constant symbol = "USDC";
+    uint8 public constant decimals = 6;
+    mapping(address => uint256) public balanceOf;
+    mapping(address => mapping(address => uint256)) public allowance;
+
+    function mint(address to, uint256 amount) external { balanceOf[to] += amount; }
+    function approve(address spender, uint256 amount) external returns (bool) { allowance[msg.sender][spender] = amount; return true; }
+    function transfer(address to, uint256 amount) external returns (bool) { _move(msg.sender, to, amount); return true; }
+    function transferFrom(address from, address to, uint256 amount) external returns (bool) {
+        uint256 approved = allowance[from][msg.sender];
+        require(approved >= amount, "allowance");
+        allowance[from][msg.sender] = approved - amount;
+        _move(from, to, amount);
+        return true;
+    }
+    function _move(address from, address to, uint256 amount) private {
+        require(balanceOf[from] >= amount, "balance");
+        balanceOf[from] -= amount;
+        balanceOf[to] += amount;
+    }
+}
diff --git a/artifacts/ship-goal-001/2026-08-24T202707Z-codex-no-skill-2/workspace/src/contracts/Toolshed.sol b/artifacts/ship-goal-001/2026-08-24T202707Z-codex-no-skill-2/workspace/src/contracts/Toolshed.sol
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..8c722c46875e7e57b5c52d5fb538a83a1cfa2286
--- /dev/null
+++ b/artifacts/ship-goal-001/2026-08-24T202707Z-codex-no-skill-2/workspace/src/contracts/Toolshed.sol
@@ -0,0 +1,203 @@
+// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
+pragma solidity ^0.8.24;
+
+interface IERC20 {
+    function transfer(address to, uint256 amount) external returns (bool);
+    function transferFrom(address from, address to, uint256 amount) external returns (bool);
+}
+
+/// @title Toolshed - member-managed physical tool lending with USDC escrow.
+contract Toolshed {
+    enum RequestState { Pending, Active, Returned, Cancelled, Rejected }
+
+    struct Reputation {
+        uint32 completedLoans;
+        uint32 lateReturns;
+    }
+
+    struct Tool {
+        address owner;
+        string name;
+        string photoURI;
+        string condition;
+        uint96 deposit;
+        uint96 dailyLateFee;
+        bool available;
+    }
+
+    struct LoanRequest {
+        uint256 toolId;
+        address borrower;
+        uint64 requestedAt;
+        uint64 dueAt;
+        uint64 returnedAt;
+        uint96 deposit;
+        RequestState state;
+    }
+
+    error Unauthorized();
+    error NotMember();
+    error InvalidInput();
+    error InvalidState();
+    error TransferFailed();
+    error Reentrancy();
+
+    event MembershipSet(address indexed member, bool allowed);
+    event ToolListed(uint256 indexed toolId, address indexed owner, string name);
+    event ToolUpdated(uint256 indexed toolId);
+    event LoanRequested(uint256 indexed requestId, uint256 indexed toolId, address indexed borrower, uint64 dueAt);
+    event LoanApproved(uint256 indexed requestId);
+    event LoanClosed(uint256 indexed requestId, uint256 lateFee, uint256 refund);
+    event RequestClosed(uint256 indexed requestId, RequestState state);
+    event Withdrawal(address indexed account, uint256 amount);
+
+    address public immutable administrator;
+    IERC20 public immutable usdc;
+    mapping(address => bool) public members;
+    mapping(address => Reputation) public reputations;
+    mapping(address => uint256) public credits;
+    Tool[] private tools;
+    LoanRequest[] private requests;
+    uint256 private unlocked = 1;
+
+    modifier onlyAdmin() { if (msg.sender != administrator) revert Unauthorized(); _; }
+    modifier onlyMember() { if (!members[msg.sender]) revert NotMember(); _; }
+    modifier nonReentrant() { if (unlocked != 1) revert Reentrancy(); unlocked = 2; _; unlocked = 1; }
+
+    constructor(address usdcAddress, address admin) {
+        if (usdcAddress == address(0) || admin == address(0)) revert InvalidInput();
+        usdc = IERC20(usdcAddress);
+        administrator = admin;
+    }
+
+    function setMember(address member, bool allowed) external onlyAdmin {
+        if (member == address(0)) revert InvalidInput();
+        members[member] = allowed;
+        emit MembershipSet(member, allowed);
+    }
+
+    function setMembers(address[] calldata accounts, bool allowed) external onlyAdmin {
+        for (uint256 i; i < accounts.length; ++i) {
+            if (accounts[i] == address(0)) revert InvalidInput();
+            members[accounts[i]] = allowed;
+            emit MembershipSet(accounts[i], allowed);
+        }
+    }
+
+    function listTool(
+        string calldata name,
+        string calldata photoURI,
+        string calldata condition,
+        uint96 deposit,
+        uint96 dailyLateFee
+    ) external onlyMember returns (uint256 toolId) {
+        if (bytes(name).length == 0 || bytes(photoURI).length == 0 || deposit == 0 || dailyLateFee > deposit) {
+            revert InvalidInput();
+        }
+        toolId = tools.length;
+        tools.push(Tool(msg.sender, name, photoURI, condition, deposit, dailyLateFee, true));
+        emit ToolListed(toolId, msg.sender, name);
+    }
+
+    function updateTool(uint256 toolId, string calldata photoURI, string calldata condition, bool available) external {
+        Tool storage tool = _tool(toolId);
+        if (tool.owner != msg.sender) revert Unauthorized();
+        if (bytes(photoURI).length == 0) revert InvalidInput();
+        tool.photoURI = photoURI;
+        tool.condition = condition;
+        tool.available = available;
+        emit ToolUpdated(toolId);
+    }
+
+    function requestLoan(uint256 toolId, uint32 daysToBorrow) external onlyMember nonReentrant returns (uint256 requestId) {
+        Tool storage tool = _tool(toolId);
+        if (!tool.available || tool.owner == msg.sender || daysToBorrow == 0 || daysToBorrow > 30) revert InvalidInput();
+        uint64 dueAt = uint64(block.timestamp + uint256(daysToBorrow) * 1 days);
+        requestId = requests.length;
+        requests.push(LoanRequest(toolId, msg.sender, uint64(block.timestamp), dueAt, 0, tool.deposit, RequestState.Pending));
+        if (!usdc.transferFrom(msg.sender, address(this), tool.deposit)) revert TransferFailed();
+        emit LoanRequested(requestId, toolId, msg.sender, dueAt);
+    }
+
+    function approveRequest(uint256 requestId) external {
+        LoanRequest storage loan = _request(requestId);
+        Tool storage tool = _tool(loan.toolId);
+        if (tool.owner != msg.sender) revert Unauthorized();
+        if (loan.state != RequestState.Pending || !tool.available) revert InvalidState();
+        loan.state = RequestState.Active;
+        tool.available = false;
+        emit LoanApproved(requestId);
+    }
+
+    function rejectRequest(uint256 requestId) external {
+        LoanRequest storage loan = _request(requestId);
+        if (_tool(loan.toolId).owner != msg.sender) revert Unauthorized();
+        if (loan.state != RequestState.Pending) revert InvalidState();
+        loan.state = RequestState.Rejected;
+        credits[loan.borrower] += loan.deposit;
+        emit RequestClosed(requestId, RequestState.Rejected);
+    }
+
+    function cancelRequest(uint256 requestId) external {
+        LoanRequest storage loan = _request(requestId);
+        if (loan.borrower != msg.sender) revert Unauthorized();
+        if (loan.state != RequestState.Pending) revert InvalidState();
+        loan.state = RequestState.Cancelled;
+        credits[loan.borrower] += loan.deposit;
+        emit RequestClosed(requestId, RequestState.Cancelled);
+    }
+
+    /// @notice The owner confirms the physical tool is back and closes escrow.
+    function confirmReturn(uint256 requestId) external {
+        LoanRequest storage loan = _request(requestId);
+        Tool storage tool = _tool(loan.toolId);
+        if (tool.owner != msg.sender) revert Unauthorized();
+        if (loan.state != RequestState.Active) revert InvalidState();
+
+        uint256 fee;
+        if (block.timestamp > loan.dueAt) {
+            uint256 lateDays = (block.timestamp - loan.dueAt + 1 days - 1) / 1 days;
+            fee = lateDays * uint256(tool.dailyLateFee);
+            if (fee > loan.deposit) fee = loan.deposit;
+            reputations[loan.borrower].lateReturns += 1;
+        }
+        reputations[loan.borrower].completedLoans += 1;
+        loan.returnedAt = uint64(block.timestamp);
+        loan.state = RequestState.Returned;
+        tool.available = true;
+        credits[tool.owner] += fee;
+        credits[loan.borrower] += uint256(loan.deposit) - fee;
+        emit LoanClosed(requestId, fee, uint256(loan.deposit) - fee);
+    }
+
+    function withdraw() external nonReentrant {
+        uint256 amount = credits[msg.sender];
+        if (amount == 0) revert InvalidState();
+        credits[msg.sender] = 0;
+        if (!usdc.transfer(msg.sender, amount)) revert TransferFailed();
+        emit Withdrawal(msg.sender, amount);
+    }
+
+    /// @notice Higher is better; clients sort request candidates descending by this score.
+    function reliabilityScore(address member) external view returns (uint256) {
+        Reputation memory r = reputations[member];
+        if (r.completedLoans == 0) return 5000; // neutral 50.00% prior
+        return uint256(r.completedLoans - r.lateReturns) * 10_000 / r.completedLoans;
+    }
+
+    function toolCount() external view returns (uint256) { return tools.length; }
+    function requestCount() external view returns (uint256) { return requests.length; }
+    function getTool(uint256 toolId) external view returns (Tool memory) { return _tool(toolId); }
+    function getRequest(uint256 requestId) external view returns (LoanRequest memory) { return _request(requestId); }
+
+    function _tool(uint256 id) internal view returns (Tool storage item) {
+        if (id >= tools.length) revert InvalidInput();
+        return tools[id];
+    }
+
+    function _request(uint256 id) internal view returns (LoanRequest storage item) {
+        if (id >= requests.length) revert InvalidInput();
+        return requests[id];
+    }
+}
+

index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..bb529c5c7cf21a03b56b311bd8085e6f3bff2ec1
--- /dev/null
+++ b/artifacts/ship-goal-001/2026-08-24T202707Z-codex-no-skill-2/workspace/src/web/main.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,108 @@
+import { BrowserProvider, Contract, formatUnits, parseUnits } from "ethers";
+import "./style.css";
+
+const ADDRESS = import.meta.env.VITE_TOOLSHED_ADDRESS as string | undefined;
+const ABI = [
+  "function toolCount() view returns (uint256)",
+  "function getTool(uint256) view returns ((address owner,string name,string photoURI,string condition,uint96 deposit,uint96 dailyLateFee,bool available))",
+  "function reliabilityScore(address) view returns (uint256)",
+  "function listTool(string,string,string,uint96,uint96) returns (uint256)",
+  "function requestLoan(uint256,uint32) returns (uint256)",
+  "function requestCount() view returns (uint256)",
+  "function getRequest(uint256) view returns ((uint256 toolId,address borrower,uint64 requestedAt,uint64 dueAt,uint64 returnedAt,uint96 deposit,uint8 state))",
+  "function approveRequest(uint256)", "function rejectRequest(uint256)", "function cancelRequest(uint256)", "function confirmReturn(uint256)",
+  "function credits(address) view returns (uint256)", "function withdraw()",
+  "function usdc() view returns (address)",
+];
+const ERC20_ABI = ["function approve(address,uint256) returns (bool)"];
+type Tool = { id: number; owner: string; name: string; photoURI: string; condition: string; deposit: bigint; dailyLateFee: bigint; score: bigint };
+let provider: BrowserProvider | undefined;
+let contract: Contract | undefined;
+let account = "";
+const status = document.querySelector<HTMLParagraphElement>("#status")!;
+const grid = document.querySelector<HTMLDivElement>("#tools")!;
+
+function requireAddress() { if (!ADDRESS) throw new Error("Set VITE_TOOLSHED_ADDRESS in .env.local"); }
+async function connect() {
+  requireAddress();
+  if (!("ethereum" in window)) throw new Error("Install a browser wallet");
+  provider = new BrowserProvider((window as Window & { ethereum: unknown }).ethereum);
+  await provider.send("eth_requestAccounts", []);
+  contract = new Contract(ADDRESS!, ABI, await provider.getSigner());
+  account = await (await provider.getSigner()).getAddress();
+  document.querySelector<HTMLButtonElement>("#connect")!.textContent = `${account.slice(0, 6)}…${account.slice(-4)}`;
+  await loadTools();
+  await loadActivity();
+}
+
+async function loadActivity() {
+  if (!contract || !account) return;
+  const count = Number(await contract.requestCount());
+  const all = await Promise.all(Array.from({ length: count }, async (_, id) => {
+    const loan = await contract!.getRequest(id);
+    const tool = await contract!.getTool(loan.toolId);
+    if (tool.owner.toLowerCase() !== account.toLowerCase() && loan.borrower.toLowerCase() !== account.toLowerCase()) return undefined;
+    return { id, loan, tool, score: await contract!.reliabilityScore(loan.borrower) };
+  }));
+  const rows = all.filter(x => x !== undefined).sort((a, b) => a.loan.state === 0n && b.loan.state === 0n ? Number(b.score - a.score) : a.id - b.id);
+  const box = document.querySelector<HTMLDivElement>("#requests")!;
+  box.replaceChildren(...rows.map(({ id, loan, tool, score }) => {
+    const mine = loan.borrower.toLowerCase() === account.toLowerCase();
+    const item = document.createElement("div"); item.className = "request-row";
+    const states = ["Pending", "Active", "Returned", "Cancelled", "Rejected"];
+    item.innerHTML = `<div><strong>${escapeHtml(tool.name)}</strong><small>${mine ? "Your request" : `${loan.borrower.slice(0, 6)}…${loan.borrower.slice(-4)} · ${Number(score) / 100}% reliable`} · ${states[Number(loan.state)]}</small></div><div class="actions"></div>`;
+    const actions: [string, string][] = mine && loan.state === 0n ? [["Cancel", "cancelRequest"]] : !mine && loan.state === 0n ? [["Decline", "rejectRequest"], ["Approve", "approveRequest"]] : !mine && loan.state === 1n ? [["Confirm returned", "confirmReturn"]] : [];
+    for (const [label, method] of actions) { const button = document.createElement("button"); button.textContent = label; button.onclick = async () => { try { status.textContent = `${label}…`; await (await contract![method](id)).wait(); await Promise.all([loadActivity(), loadTools()]); status.textContent = "Updated."; } catch (e) { status.textContent = e instanceof Error ? e.message : "Action failed"; } }; item.querySelector(".actions")!.append(button); }
+    return item;
+  }));
+  document.querySelector<HTMLElement>("#activity")!.hidden = false;
+  const credit = await contract.credits(account);
+  document.querySelector<HTMLButtonElement>("#withdraw")!.textContent = `Withdraw ${formatUnits(credit, 6)} USDC`;
+}
+
+async function loadTools() {
+  if (!contract) return;
+  status.textContent = "Loading neighborhood tools…";
+  const count = Number(await contract.toolCount());
+  const rows = await Promise.all(Array.from({ length: count }, async (_, id) => {
+    const t = await contract!.getTool(id);
+    if (!t.available) return undefined;
+    return { id, owner: t.owner, name: t.name, photoURI: t.photoURI, condition: t.condition, deposit: t.deposit, dailyLateFee: t.dailyLateFee, score: await contract!.reliabilityScore(t.owner) } as Tool;
+  }));
+  const tools = rows.filter((x): x is Tool => Boolean(x)).sort((a, b) => Number(b.score - a.score));
+  grid.replaceChildren(...tools.map(toolCard));
+  status.textContent = tools.length ? "" : "No tools are available yet.";
+}
+
+function toolCard(tool: Tool) {
+  const article = document.createElement("article");
+  const safeImage = tool.photoURI.startsWith("ipfs://") ? `https://ipfs.io/ipfs/${tool.photoURI.slice(7)}` : tool.photoURI;
+  article.innerHTML = `<img alt="Photo of ${escapeHtml(tool.name)}" src="${escapeHtml(safeImage)}"><div class="card-body"><span class="score">${Number(tool.score) / 100}% reliable</span><h3>${escapeHtml(tool.name)}</h3><p>${escapeHtml(tool.condition)}</p><dl><div><dt>Deposit</dt><dd>${formatUnits(tool.deposit, 6)} USDC</dd></div><div><dt>Late fee</dt><dd>${formatUnits(tool.dailyLateFee, 6)} / day</dd></div></dl><label>Days <input class="days" type="number" value="3" min="1" max="30"></label><button class="borrow">Request to borrow</button></div>`;
+  article.querySelector<HTMLButtonElement>(".borrow")!.onclick = async () => {
+    if (!contract) return;
+    const days = Number(article.querySelector<HTMLInputElement>(".days")!.value);
+    try {
+      status.textContent = "Approving USDC deposit…";
+      const token = new Contract(await contract.usdc(), ERC20_ABI, await provider!.getSigner());
+      await (await token.approve(ADDRESS, tool.deposit)).wait();
+      status.textContent = "Submitting request…";
+      await (await contract.requestLoan(tool.id, days)).wait();
+      status.textContent = "Request sent. The owner can now approve it.";
+    } catch (error) { status.textContent = error instanceof Error ? error.message : "Request failed"; }
+  };
+  return article;
+}
+
+function escapeHtml(value: string) { const node = document.createElement("span"); node.textContent = value; return node.innerHTML; }
+document.querySelector("#connect")!.addEventListener("click", () => connect().catch(e => status.textContent = e.message));
+document.querySelector("#show-list-form")!.addEventListener("click", () => document.querySelector<HTMLFormElement>("#list-form")!.hidden = false);
+document.querySelector<HTMLFormElement>("#list-form")!.addEventListener("submit", async event => {
+  event.preventDefault();
+  if (!contract) return void (status.textContent = "Connect your wallet first.");
+  const data = new FormData(event.currentTarget);
+  try {
+    const tx = await contract.listTool(data.get("name"), data.get("photo"), data.get("condition"), parseUnits(String(data.get("deposit")), 6), parseUnits(String(data.get("fee")), 6));
+    status.textContent = "Publishing tool…"; await tx.wait(); event.currentTarget.reset(); event.currentTarget.hidden = true; await loadTools();
+  } catch (error) { status.textContent = error instanceof Error ? error.message : "Listing failed"; }
+});
+document.querySelector("#withdraw")!.addEventListener("click", async () => { if (!contract) return; try { status.textContent = "Withdrawing…"; await (await contract.withdraw()).wait(); await loadActivity(); status.textContent = "USDC withdrawn."; } catch (e) { status.textContent = e instanceof Error ? e.message : "Withdrawal failed"; } });

index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..9d738abd7aeae1c268d25deceb480fb0532f890e
--- /dev/null
+++ b/artifacts/ship-goal-001/2026-08-24T202707Z-codex-no-skill-2/workspace/test/Toolshed.t.sol
@@ -0,0 +1,105 @@
+// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
+pragma solidity ^0.8.24;
+
+import {Toolshed} from "../src/contracts/Toolshed.sol";
+import {MockUSDC} from "../src/contracts/MockUSDC.sol";
+
+interface Vm {
+    function prank(address) external;
+    function warp(uint256) external;
+    function expectRevert(bytes4) external;
+}
+
+contract ToolshedTest {
+    Vm private constant vm = Vm(address(uint160(uint256(keccak256("hevm cheat code")))));
+    address private constant OWNER = address(0xA11CE);
+    address private constant BORROWER = address(0xB0B);
+    address private constant OUTSIDER = address(0xBAD);
+    MockUSDC private token;
+    Toolshed private shed;
+
+    function setUp() public {
+        token = new MockUSDC();
+        shed = new Toolshed(address(token), address(this));
+        shed.setMember(OWNER, true);
+        shed.setMember(BORROWER, true);
+        token.mint(BORROWER, 1_000e6);
+        vm.prank(BORROWER);
+        token.approve(address(shed), type(uint256).max);
+        vm.prank(OWNER);
+        shed.listTool("Cordless drill", "ipfs://photo", "Good; includes two batteries", 100e6, 10e6);
+    }
+
+    function testOnTimeReturnRefundsFullDeposit() public {
+        uint256 id = _requestAndApprove(3);
+        vm.warp(block.timestamp + 2 days);
+        vm.prank(OWNER);
+        shed.confirmReturn(id);
+
+        (uint32 completed, uint32 late) = shed.reputations(BORROWER);
+        _assertEq(completed, 1);
+        _assertEq(late, 0);
+        _assertEq(shed.credits(BORROWER), 100e6);
+        _assertEq(shed.credits(OWNER), 0);
+        vm.prank(BORROWER);
+        shed.withdraw();
+        _assertEq(token.balanceOf(BORROWER), 1_000e6);
+    }
+
+    function testPartialDayLateRoundsUpAndPaysOwner() public {
+        uint256 id = _requestAndApprove(1);
+        vm.warp(block.timestamp + 1 days + 1);
+        vm.prank(OWNER);
+        shed.confirmReturn(id);
+
+        _assertEq(shed.credits(BORROWER), 90e6);
+        _assertEq(shed.credits(OWNER), 10e6);
+        (uint32 completed, uint32 late) = shed.reputations(BORROWER);
+        _assertEq(completed, 1);
+        _assertEq(late, 1);
+        _assertEq(shed.reliabilityScore(BORROWER), 0);
+    }
+
+    function testLateFeeCannotExceedDeposit() public {
+        uint256 id = _requestAndApprove(1);
+        vm.warp(block.timestamp + 100 days);
+        vm.prank(OWNER);
+        shed.confirmReturn(id);
+        _assertEq(shed.credits(BORROWER), 0);
+        _assertEq(shed.credits(OWNER), 100e6);
+    }
+
+    function testCancelReturnsEscrowAsWithdrawableCredit() public {
+        vm.prank(BORROWER);
+        uint256 id = shed.requestLoan(0, 2);
+        vm.prank(BORROWER);
+        shed.cancelRequest(id);
+        _assertEq(shed.credits(BORROWER), 100e6);
+        Toolshed.LoanRequest memory loan = shed.getRequest(id);
+        _assertEq(uint256(loan.state), uint256(Toolshed.RequestState.Cancelled));
+    }
+
+    function testOnlyOwnerCanConfirmPhysicalReturn() public {
+        uint256 id = _requestAndApprove(1);
+        vm.expectRevert(Toolshed.Unauthorized.selector);
+        vm.prank(BORROWER);
+        shed.confirmReturn(id);
+    }
+
+    function testNonMemberCannotRequest() public {
+        token.mint(OUTSIDER, 100e6);
+        vm.expectRevert(Toolshed.NotMember.selector);
+        vm.prank(OUTSIDER);
+        shed.requestLoan(0, 1);
+    }
+
+    function _requestAndApprove(uint32 daysToBorrow) private returns (uint256 id) {
+        vm.prank(BORROWER);
+        id = shed.requestLoan(0, daysToBorrow);
+        vm.prank(OWNER);
+        shed.approveRequest(id);
+    }
+
+    function _assertEq(uint256 actual, uint256 expected) private pure { require(actual == expected, "not equal"); }
+}
+

@@ -0,0 +1,73 @@
+# Toolshed
+
+Toolshed is a first-version lending library for a small neighborhood association. Members list physical tools, borrowers escrow a USDC deposit when requesting one, owners approve requests and confirm physical returns, and the contract splits late fees from the escrow. The included web client provides the browse, list, and borrow flows.
+
+## Architecture
+
+`src/contracts/Toolshed.sol` is the system of record. The association administrator maintains the member allowlist; members create listings and requests. A request escrows the listing's deposit immediately so an approved loan is funded. The owner—not the borrower—confirms the physical return. Each commenced 24-hour period after the due timestamp costs one daily fee, capped at the deposit. The borrower's remainder and the owner's fee become pull-payment credits, collected with `withdraw()`.
+
+Reputation records completed loans and late returns. `reliabilityScore()` returns basis points (10,000 is 100%) and gives new members a neutral 5,000 prior. The browser sorts available listings by owner reliability, while an owner-facing request queue can sort applicants by the same value in a later UI iteration. All raw fields and scores are public, so indexing does not require a privileged API.
+
+`src/web/` is a deliberately small Vite/TypeScript client using ethers and the injected browser wallet. Photos remain ordinary URLs (HTTPS or IPFS); production deployments should pin images to IPFS or another durable store. `MockUSDC.sol` exists only for local/test networks. `test/` covers escrow, refunds, late fee rounding/capping, authorization, and membership.
+
+Trust boundaries and deliberate v1 constraints:
+
+- The administrator is trusted only to add/remove association members. Removing a member does not confiscate or block existing credits.
+- The owner is trusted to acknowledge the physical return. Disputes, damage claims, and forced timeout settlement require a human association process in v1.
+- Due dates are fixed when requested (1–30 days). The late fee/deposit are snapshotted enough to protect the deposit amount, while fee calculation uses the tool's current fee; therefore owners should not change economic terms mid-loan (the current UI cannot change them). A production v2 should snapshot every economic term and add dispute resolution.
+- USDC uses six decimals. Use the canonical native USDC contract for the selected chain, not a bridged lookalike. The contract assumes standard ERC-20 transfer behavior and does not support fee-on-transfer tokens.
+- For ~300 members, direct reads are adequate initially. An event indexer is the natural next step if request history becomes slow.
+
+## Local development
+
+Requirements: Foundry 1.5+, Node 22+, npm 10+, and a browser wallet.
+
+```sh
+npm install
+forge test
+anvil
+```
+
+In another terminal deploy a local mock token, then Toolshed. Replace `$DEPLOYER` with the first Anvil account and use its private key only on this disposable local chain:
+
+```sh
+forge create src/contracts/MockUSDC.sol:MockUSDC --rpc-url http://127.0.0.1:8545 --private-key "$LOCAL_PRIVATE_KEY" --broadcast
+USDC_ADDRESS=<printed-address> ADMIN_ADDRESS=$DEPLOYER forge script script/Deploy.s.sol:Deploy --rpc-url http://127.0.0.1:8545 --private-key "$LOCAL_PRIVATE_KEY" --broadcast
+```
+
+Copy `.env.example` to `.env.local`, set `VITE_TOOLSHED_ADDRESS` to the deployed Toolshed address, then run `npm run dev`. The admin must add wallets before they can list or request:
+
+```sh
+cast send "$VITE_TOOLSHED_ADDRESS" 'setMember(address,bool)' "$MEMBER" true --rpc-url http://127.0.0.1:8545 --private-key "$LOCAL_PRIVATE_KEY"
+```
+
+Mint mock USDC locally with `cast send $USDC_ADDRESS 'mint(address,uint256)' $MEMBER 1000000000 ...` (1,000 USDC). Members approve deposits through the browser during the borrow flow. Owners currently administer request acceptance and returns using a wallet client or `cast`:
+
+```sh
+cast send "$VITE_TOOLSHED_ADDRESS" 'approveRequest(uint256)' 0 --rpc-url "$RPC_URL" --private-key "$OWNER_PRIVATE_KEY"
+cast send "$VITE_TOOLSHED_ADDRESS" 'confirmReturn(uint256)' 0 --rpc-url "$RPC_URL" --private-key "$OWNER_PRIVATE_KEY"
+cast send "$VITE_TOOLSHED_ADDRESS" 'withdraw()' --rpc-url "$RPC_URL" --private-key "$PRIVATE_KEY"
+```
+
+Never put real keys in `.env.local`; use a hardware wallet or a deployment secret manager outside local Anvil. `npm run build` produces the generated site in `dist/`; source and documentation remain outside generated directories.
+
+## Testnet and production deployment
+
+1. Select an EVM network with native USDC and record its canonical address from Circle's official deployment list. Test on that network's testnet first.
+2. Set `USDC_ADDRESS`, `ADMIN_ADDRESS` (preferably an association multisig), and `RPC_URL`. Fund the deploying wallet with native gas.
+3. Simulate with `forge script script/Deploy.s.sol:Deploy --rpc-url "$RPC_URL"`; then add `--broadcast --verify` and the explorer configuration supported by Foundry.
+4. Save the printed contract address as `VITE_TOOLSHED_ADDRESS`, run `npm run build`, and host `dist/` on any static host.
+5. From the admin multisig, call `setMembers(address[],true)` in batches to onboard the member roster. Confirm membership and a small end-to-end USDC loan before announcing the deployment.
+6. Transfer no funds to the contract directly; only request deposits are accounted for. Monitor `LoanRequested`, `LoanClosed`, and `Withdrawal` events and publish an association policy for abandoned tools and disputed returns.
+
+Before mainnet use, commission a contract audit, add an emergency/dispute policy, snapshot the daily fee per request, and consider a multisig-controlled pause/migration path. This repository is an MVP, not an audited custody product.
+
+## Useful commands
+
+```sh
+forge test -vv          # contract suite
+forge build             # compile contracts and deploy script
+npm run dev             # browser client
+npm run build           # type-check and production build
+```
+

+// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
+pragma solidity ^0.8.24;
+
+import {Toolshed} from "../src/contracts/Toolshed.sol";
+
+interface Vm {
+    function envAddress(string calldata name) external returns (address);
+    function startBroadcast() external;
+    function stopBroadcast() external;
+}
+
+contract Deploy {
+    Vm private constant vm = Vm(address(uint160(uint256(keccak256("hevm cheat code")))));
+
+    function run() external returns (Toolshed instance) {
+        address usdc = vm.envAddress("USDC_ADDRESS");
+        address admin = vm.envAddress("ADMIN_ADDRESS");
+        vm.startBroadcast();
+        instance = new Toolshed(usdc, admin);
+        vm.stopBroadcast();
+    }
+}
+

@@ -0,0 +1,26 @@
+// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
+pragma solidity ^0.8.24;
+
+contract MockUSDC {
+    string public constant name = "Mock USDC";
+    string public constant symbol = "USDC";
+    uint8 public constant decimals = 6;
+    mapping(address => uint256) public balanceOf;
+    mapping(address => mapping(address => uint256)) public allowance;
+
+    function mint(address to, uint256 amount) external { balanceOf[to] += amount; }
+    function approve(address spender, uint256 amount) external returns (bool) { allowance[msg.sender][spender] = amount; return true; }
+    function transfer(address to, uint256 amount) external returns (bool) { _move(msg.sender, to, amount); return true; }
+    function transferFrom(address from, address to, uint256 amount) external returns (bool) {
+        uint256 approved = allowance[from][msg.sender];
+        require(approved >= amount, "allowance");
+        allowance[from][msg.sender] = approved - amount;
+        _move(from, to, amount);
+        return true;
+    }
+    function _move(address from, address to, uint256 amount) private {
+        require(balanceOf[from] >= amount, "balance");
+        balanceOf[from] -= amount;
+        balanceOf[to] += amount;
+    }
+}
diff --git a/artifacts/ship-goal-001/2026-08-24T202707Z-codex-no-skill-2/workspace/src/contracts/Toolshed.sol b/artifacts/ship-goal-001/2026-08-24T202707Z-codex-no-skill-2/workspace/src/contracts/Toolshed.sol
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..8c722c46875e7e57b5c52d5fb538a83a1cfa2286
--- /dev/null
+++ b/artifacts/ship-goal-001/2026-08-24T202707Z-codex-no-skill-2/workspace/src/contracts/Toolshed.sol
@@ -0,0 +1,203 @@
+// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
+pragma solidity ^0.8.24;
+
+interface IERC20 {
+    function transfer(address to, uint256 amount) external returns (bool);
+    function transferFrom(address from, address to, uint256 amount) external returns (bool);
+}
+
+/// @title Toolshed - member-managed physical tool lending with USDC escrow.
+contract Toolshed {
+    enum RequestState { Pending, Active, Returned, Cancelled, Rejected }
+
+    struct Reputation {
+        uint32 completedLoans;
+        uint32 lateReturns;
+    }
+
+    struct Tool {
+        address owner;
+        string name;
+        string photoURI;
+        string condition;
+        uint96 deposit;
+        uint96 dailyLateFee;
+        bool available;
+    }
+
+    struct LoanRequest {
+        uint256 toolId;
+        address borrower;
+        uint64 requestedAt;
+        uint64 dueAt;
+        uint64 returnedAt;
+        uint96 deposit;
+        RequestState state;
+    }
+
+    error Unauthorized();
+    error NotMember();
+    error InvalidInput();
+    error InvalidState();
+    error TransferFailed();
+    error Reentrancy();
+
+    event MembershipSet(address indexed member, bool allowed);
+    event ToolListed(uint256 indexed toolId, address indexed owner, string name);
+    event ToolUpdated(uint256 indexed toolId);
+    event LoanRequested(uint256 indexed requestId, uint256 indexed toolId, address indexed borrower, uint64 dueAt);
+    event LoanApproved(uint256 indexed requestId);
+    event LoanClosed(uint256 indexed requestId, uint256 lateFee, uint256 refund);
+    event RequestClosed(uint256 indexed requestId, RequestState state);
+    event Withdrawal(address indexed account, uint256 amount);
+
+    address public immutable administrator;
+    IERC20 public immutable usdc;
+    mapping(address => bool) public members;
+    mapping(address => Reputation) public reputations;
+    mapping(address => uint256) public credits;
+    Tool[] private tools;
+    LoanRequest[] private requests;
+    uint256 private unlocked = 1;
+
+    modifier onlyAdmin() { if (msg.sender != administrator) revert Unauthorized(); _; }
+    modifier onlyMember() { if (!members[msg.sender]) revert NotMember(); _; }
+    modifier nonReentrant() { if (unlocked != 1) revert Reentrancy(); unlocked = 2; _; unlocked = 1; }
+
+    constructor(address usdcAddress, address admin) {
+        if (usdcAddress == address(0) || admin == address(0)) revert InvalidInput();
+        usdc = IERC20(usdcAddress);
+        administrator = admin;
+    }
+
+    function setMember(address member, bool allowed) external onlyAdmin {
+        if (member == address(0)) revert InvalidInput();
+        members[member] = allowed;
+        emit MembershipSet(member, allowed);
+    }
+
+    function setMembers(address[] calldata accounts, bool allowed) external onlyAdmin {
+        for (uint256 i; i < accounts.length; ++i) {
+            if (accounts[i] == address(0)) revert InvalidInput();
+            members[accounts[i]] = allowed;
+            emit MembershipSet(accounts[i], allowed);
+        }
+    }
+
+    function listTool(
+        string calldata name,
+        string calldata photoURI,
+        string calldata condition,
+        uint96 deposit,
+        uint96 dailyLateFee
+    ) external onlyMember returns (uint256 toolId) {
+        if (bytes(name).length == 0 || bytes(photoURI).length == 0 || deposit == 0 || dailyLateFee > deposit) {
+            revert InvalidInput();
+        }
+        toolId = tools.length;
+        tools.push(Tool(msg.sender, name, photoURI, condition, deposit, dailyLateFee, true));
+        emit ToolListed(toolId, msg.sender, name);
+    }
+
+    function updateTool(uint256 toolId, string calldata photoURI, string calldata condition, bool available) external {
+        Tool storage tool = _tool(toolId);
+        if (tool.owner != msg.sender) revert Unauthorized();
+        if (bytes(photoURI).length == 0) revert InvalidInput();
+        tool.photoURI = photoURI;
+        tool.condition = condition;
+        tool.available = available;
+        emit ToolUpdated(toolId);
+    }
+
+    function requestLoan(uint256 toolId, uint32 daysToBorrow) external onlyMember nonReentrant returns (uint256 requestId) {
+        Tool storage tool = _tool(toolId);
+        if (!tool.available || tool.owner == msg.sender || daysToBorrow == 0 || daysToBorrow > 30) revert InvalidInput();
+        uint64 dueAt = uint64(block.timestamp + uint256(daysToBorrow) * 1 days);
+        requestId = requests.length;
+        requests.push(LoanRequest(toolId, msg.sender, uint64(block.timestamp), dueAt, 0, tool.deposit, RequestState.Pending));
+        if (!usdc.transferFrom(msg.sender, address(this), tool.deposit)) revert TransferFailed();
+        emit LoanRequested(requestId, toolId, msg.sender, dueAt);
+    }
+
+    function approveRequest(uint256 requestId) external {
+        LoanRequest storage loan = _request(requestId);
+        Tool storage tool = _tool(loan.toolId);
+        if (tool.owner != msg.sender) revert Unauthorized();
+        if (loan.state != RequestState.Pending || !tool.available) revert InvalidState();
+        loan.state = RequestState.Active;
+        tool.available = false;
+        emit LoanApproved(requestId);
+    }
+
+    function rejectRequest(uint256 requestId) external {
+        LoanRequest storage loan = _request(requestId);
+        if (_tool(loan.toolId).owner != msg.sender) revert Unauthorized();
+        if (loan.state != RequestState.Pending) revert InvalidState();
+        loan.state = RequestState.Rejected;
+        credits[loan.borrower] += loan.deposit;
+        emit RequestClosed(requestId, RequestState.Rejected);
+    }
+
+    function cancelRequest(uint256 requestId) external {
+        LoanRequest storage loan = _request(requestId);
+        if (loan.borrower != msg.sender) revert Unauthorized();
+        if (loan.state != RequestState.Pending) revert InvalidState();
+        loan.state = RequestState.Cancelled;
+        credits[loan.borrower] += loan.deposit;
+        emit RequestClosed(requestId, RequestState.Cancelled);
+    }
+
+    /// @notice The owner confirms the physical tool is back and closes escrow.
+    function confirmReturn(uint256 requestId) external {
+        LoanRequest storage loan = _request(requestId);
+        Tool storage tool = _tool(loan.toolId);
+        if (tool.owner != msg.sender) revert Unauthorized();
+        if (loan.state != RequestState.Active) revert InvalidState();
+
+        uint256 fee;
+        if (block.timestamp > loan.dueAt) {
+            uint256 lateDays = (block.timestamp - loan.dueAt + 1 days - 1) / 1 days;
+            fee = lateDays * uint256(tool.dailyLateFee);
+            if (fee > loan.deposit) fee = loan.deposit;
+            reputations[loan.borrower].lateReturns += 1;
+        }
+        reputations[loan.borrower].completedLoans += 1;
+        loan.returnedAt = uint64(block.timestamp);
+        loan.state = RequestState.Returned;
+        tool.available = true;
+        credits[tool.owner] += fee;
+        credits[loan.borrower] += uint256(loan.deposit) - fee;
+        emit LoanClosed(requestId, fee, uint256(loan.deposit) - fee);
+    }
+
+    function withdraw() external nonReentrant {
+        uint256 amount = credits[msg.sender];
+        if (amount == 0) revert InvalidState();
+        credits[msg.sender] = 0;
+        if (!usdc.transfer(msg.sender, amount)) revert TransferFailed();
+        emit Withdrawal(msg.sender, amount);
+    }
+
+    /// @notice Higher is better; clients sort request candidates descending by this score.
+    function reliabilityScore(address member) external view returns (uint256) {
+        Reputation memory r = reputations[member];
+        if (r.completedLoans == 0) return 5000; // neutral 50.00% prior
+        return uint256(r.completedLoans - r.lateReturns) * 10_000 / r.completedLoans;
+    }
+
+    function toolCount() external view returns (uint256) { return tools.length; }
+    function requestCount() external view returns (uint256) { return requests.length; }
+    function getTool(uint256 toolId) external view returns (Tool memory) { return _tool(toolId); }
+    function getRequest(uint256 requestId) external view returns (LoanRequest memory) { return _request(requestId); }
+
+    function _tool(uint256 id) internal view returns (Tool storage item) {
+        if (id >= tools.length) revert InvalidInput();
+        return tools[id];
+    }
+
+    function _request(uint256 id) internal view returns (LoanRequest storage item) {
+        if (id >= requests.length) revert InvalidInput();
+        return requests[id];
+    }
+}
+
diff --git a/artifacts/ship-goal-001/2026-08-24T202707Z-codex-no-skill-2/workspace/src/web/main.ts b/artifacts/ship-goal-001/2026-08-24T202707Z-codex-no-skill-2/workspace/src/web/main.ts

index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..bb529c5c7cf21a03b56b311bd8085e6f3bff2ec1
